josip and anna, with ante

a studio portrait: josip seated in a light suit and loose cravat, anna in a dark bodice with the high collar and gathered shoulders of the 1890s, the baby ante across her lap in a striped romper. the painted backdrop and the vignetted edge are the marks of a small provincial photographer.
from family collection (omiš branch)

a man in a white peaked cap, shirtsleeves and wide trousers, seated on a rush-bottomed chair against a whitewashed wall, a barefoot boy leaning on his shoulder. zane is the venetian form of giovanni — the same name the parish clerks wrote as zuane.
a group photograph kept with the omiš papers; the family's note places zane in the middle of the front row.
anton “toni” franceschi, 1932

dated by the family to 1932. note the surname as written on the print: franceschi, without the particle — the omiš branch dropped and resumed it by turns. the face of the print, as copied here, carries no writing (a man at the wheel of an open touring car), so the surname as written and the date are not visible on this image.

frane is the croatian form of francesco; the surname on this print is spelled the croatian way, defranceski. the face of the print, as copied here, carries no writing, so the spelling of the surname is not visible on this image.
carlo de franceschi in old age
the historian of istria, born at gologorica in 1809, photographed late in life: round spectacles, white beard, dark stock. he died in 1893.
from reproduced in the seget monograph
petar defranceski — fiche individuelle

the french-zone camp card. petar, born 15 june 1913 at crikvenica, yugoslav, profession auto-mécanicien, employer's address kelterstr. 30 neuhausen, married. five fingerprints in red, a passport photograph clipped at the top right, file 148.902 / 30609.
from international tracing service / arolsen archives
zdrafko defranceski — fiche individuelle
born 1 april 1921, yugoslav, auto-mécanicien, married. file 148.901 / 30560. the same trade as petar, and the same camp office.
ruža defranceski — fiche individuelle

born 1922, no profession recorded, married. in the photograph she wears a cross at her throat and holds her infant son, who is not named here: he is anton mario de franceski, born 21 august 1944 at reutlingen, who sailed with them to australia at four and died in 1999. this caption said «he was born in 1944 and may be living» long after the archive had his grave; corrected 23 september 2026.
foreigners registered at pfullingen, 1939–45

“aufstellung über die in der zeit vom 1. sept. 1939 – 25. april 1945 in der vorstadt pfullingen gemeldet gewesenen ausländer. hier: kroatien.” drawn up at reutlingen-pfullingen on 10 march 1947. six defranceskis are listed, four of them born at crikvenica; of the other two, one was born at reutlingen and one at fužine.
its file cover d-1.505
the tracing-service wrapper for the family: petar, his wife luise née salzer of neuhausen, and two daughters, one born at urach on 29 october 1940 and one at metzingen on 25 july 1945.
cm/1 application, identity page

the iro care-and-maintenance application, 7 november 1947. petar gives his nationality at birth as austria-hungary, his address as kelternstr. 30 neuhausen, and the country he wants to be resettled in as the united states — california.
cm/1 application, history page

residences, trades and schooling: split 1937–39 with jugoslav lloyd as a ship's engineer, then germany from april 1939; car-mechanic examination at reutlingen in 1947; a truck valued at 15,000 among his assets; and an aunt, jacomina alafetić, at san pedro, california.
felix defranceski — municipal certificate, 28 february 1950

a municipal certificate of the same printed form as anton's (the 1950 certificate shown beside it): defranceski felix, born 14.1.1908 at crikvenica, croatian-yugoslav, lodged at pfullingen, workplace hermann sauer, reutlingen-süd, dated 28 february 1950 and stamped by the town of pfullingen. this is not the sickness-fund card; the card's entries (single, pfullingerlandstraße in reutlingen, employers from july 1941 — sauer, then wilhelm heim as a driver, then sauer again) are not on this image.
ivan defranceski — sickness-fund card
ivan, born june 1925 at crikvenica, single, brunnenstraße 7, pfullingen. he entered work on 21 october 1941, aged sixteen, as a hilfsarbeiter — an unskilled hand.
petar defranceski — sickness-fund card

marked “kroate” in the top margin. employed by hermann sauer of reutlingen on motor-vehicle repairs from 1 april 1942 to 2 march 1945 — the card runs out three weeks before the french army reached the town.
zdravko defranceski — sickness-fund card
below the employment lines, a clerk has pencilled a short life: in croatia 1936–43; taken by the partisans in 1943; three or four months in captivity; then straight to germany.
anton defranceski, born 1890 — municipal certificate

certified by the mayor of pfullingen, kreis reutlingen, on 28 february 1950: anton defranceski, born 20 january 1890 at crikvenica, croatia-yugoslavia, lodged at pfullingen, workplace hermann sauer, reutlingen-süd.
resettlement roll, february 1949
lines 58–60 of a nominal roll dated 22 february 1949: zdrafko, ruža and their son, yugoslavs from crikvenica and fužine, at reutlingen, with iro numbers against each name.
državni arhiv u pazinu to david defranceski, 26 april 2021

the pazin state archive answers a request made eight days earlier: the copy from the gračišće birth register for josip defranceschi is enclosed. itemised at 117 kuna — research 50, certified a3 copy 7, overseas postage 60.
from državni arhiv u pazinu (dapa)
liber baptizatorum, gračišće 1841–1899

the lower part of the certified copy, which carries the entry, turned upright for reading (the scan is sideways). in the register's ruled table the entry numbered 23 is dated «23. martii 1863»: «josephus», «n. heri» — born the day before, which is 22 march — son of «antonius defranceschi, lapidarius», a stonecutter, and «maria fernasar». the pazin state archive's round stamp and the signature certifying the copy stand over the sheet. above the entry, rows 18 to 22 (8 to 19 march 1863) have their dates but nothing else: the data columns are blank in this copy. the upper part, with the printed headings and the first entries of the page, is the plate «the certified copy: the headed upper part»; the two scans overlap at row 17.
from državni arhiv u pazinu (dapa), mkr gračišće 1841–1899
the certified copy: the headed upper part

the upper part of the same certified copy, turned upright for reading (the scan is sideways): the printed headings of the «liber baptizatorum in ecclesia» — number, house, baptiser, the child's name and day of birth, religion, sex, legitimacy, the parents with the father's condition, the godparents — over the first entries of the year 1863, numbers 12 to 16, 23 february to 3 march. pencilled above, in a modern hand, «mkr gračišće 1841–1899» and the folio, 108. in this copy the data columns are faint or blank, and the right-hand edge of the page is cut off; the entry for josephus, 22 march 1863, is not on this part but on the lower part, shown as «liber baptizatorum, gračišće 1841–1899». the archive's second reply, of 24 june 2021 — for antonius defranceschi and his family and for giovanni battista defranceschi and his family, the two status animarum entries — cost 124 kuna; that letter itself is not reproduced on this site.
status animarum — house 5, gallignana

the book of souls for the parish of gallignana. house 5: joan. bapt. defranceschi, agricola, born 13 august 1787, married 1819, died september 1846; his wife francisca salomon, born 17 march 1797; and seven names in all — four sons, raymundus (1823), antonius (20 september 1825), joannes (1833) and franciscus liberatus (1840), and two daughters the earlier wording of this caption left out: leopoldina maria (17 november 1829) and regina theresia (19 june 1830 or 1836 — this archive's files disagree and the photocopy will not settle it). the book lists sons first, then daughters, so the dates do not run in order. ⚠ francisca, born 3 february 1819, who came out of «parochia gallignana sub n.ᵒ 5» to gologorica in 1840, is not among them: the children of this couple begin in 1823 and the marriage is 1819, so she belongs to the generation before.
from državni arhiv u pazinu (dapa), zm34k 217, m01072071
status animarum — house 19, gallignana

house 19: † antonius defranceschi q. joannis — son of the late giovanni — born 20 september 1825, married 25 november 1856, died 4 august 1894; his wife maria née fernasar, born 17 october 1832; and their children antonius, josephus, leopolda, catharina and modestus.
from državni arhiv u pazinu (dapa), zm34k 217, m01071656
anna kalanj, born 3 january 1864

entry 2 for 1864 in the baptismal register of ledenice, the vinodol parish above crikvenica. anna, legitimate, daughter of josephus kalanj and rosalia née perković, at klenovica house 22; godparents josephus ban and his wife anna; baptised by vincentius segulja, parish priest. the other entries on the page are perković, butković, mataija, semper — the surnames of one valley.
from državni arhiv / matične knjige, ledenice
carlo de franceschi signs as a witness, pazin 1842

the pisino marriage register, 13 september 1842. antonius covach, 22, of house 33, marries hedwiges mrak, 17, of house 30. in the column for witnesses: «carolus defranceschi» and «aegidius mrach», and against their names their conditions — «i. r. auscultans» and «studiosus». imperial-royal auscultator was the entry rank of the austrian judicial service. carlo was thirty-two.
from hrvatski državni arhiv, hda 583
anton rudolf, born 20 january 1890

the whole opening, pages 124–125, in place of the single strip this site carried before. entry 9, the last on the page: anton rudolf, born 20 january 1890, baptised 9 february, legitimate, son of «josip defranceschi i žena ana kalanj rodjena». residence «klenovica kbr. 22», written over «gallignana u istriji — za vičajno mjesto roditelja», gallignana in istria as the parents' place of settlement. godfather jakov kalanj of that same house 22 — his mother's people — with pavlina trković; baptised by matej butković, parish priest. the full page adds three things the strip cut off. in pencil above the child's name, in a later hand: «vjenčao se na crikvenici», he married at crikvenica. in the remarks column, why the birth happened here at all: «roditelji djeteta nahodeć se kod svojih u klenovici, t.j. kod roditelja žene ane, dobiše ovo djete, koje je u ovoj župnoj crkvi i kršteno» — the child's parents, being with their own people at klenovica, that is with the parents of the wife ana, had this child, and it was baptised in this parish church. and down the outer margin, the printer's line: «tisak h. luster u senju» — printed by h. luster at senj.
from matične knjige, ledenice / klenovica
nodburga defranceschi marries at bakar, 1794

27 february 1794, dispensed from the third banns by the bishop: in the church of the blessed virgin mary, the marriage of dominus joannes vorkret and domicella nodburga defranceschi, blessed by canon antonius de agnesis, in the presence of the vice-governor aloysius de orlando and the noble antonio maria ab orebich, assessor of the community of buccari. notburga is a tyrolean saint's name, and an odd one to find on the kvarner coast. in this copy a black box covers the lines between the year heading and the entry.
from matične knjige, bakar (buccari)
antonio defranceschi of zara — refused

a second iro application, completed at bolzano on 10 may 1950. antonio defranceschi, born 18 january 1905 at zara, ethnic group italian, son of riccardo and giuseppina zersuscek; his wife antonietta née stipanovich, born 1910, daughter of sabino stipanovich and maria lovrich. clerk at zara to 1941, then a soldier in the italian army until the capitulation, then zara again until january 1944, then italy. twice across the form, in blue crayon: not within the mandate of iro.
edoardo de franceschi dies at san daniele del friuli, 1899

atti di morte no. 28, san daniele del friuli, 12 august 1899: at five in the morning there died in the civic hospital «de franceschi edoardo, di anni quarantotto, già ufficiale, nato in zara e domiciliato in zara, figlio del fu giovanni e della fu zenardi maria, coniugato a pappafava regina» — a former officer of zadar, forty-eight, seven hundred kilometres from home.
from comune di san daniele del friuli, atti di morte
pietro de franceschi dies at san daniele del friuli, 1895

atti di morte no. 19, 30 march 1895, in the same hospital four years earlier: «de franceschi pietro, di anni quarantaquattro, mura…» — a mason, forty-four. the trade of the gračišće line, in the country the family says it came from.
josip defranceski — of the imotski branch, not this line

a hand-tinted studio portrait: dark hair swept back, a full beard, a bow tie. this archive published it as josip defranceschi of crikvenica, born at gračišće in 1863 — david's great-grandfather. that was wrong. the photograph belongs to the imotski branch and the sitter is a josip of that family, not of this line. the mistake is david's own family collection having the two branches' pictures in one place, and this archive assuming the face on a card matched the name it was filed under. no likeness of the crikvenica josip is known to this archive. corrected 9 september 2026 on david's identification.
from family collection (imotski branch)
ana — the companion portrait, now unidentified

a young woman in a high-necked dress with lace at the cuffs, hair dressed up, hand resting on a chair back, tinted the same warm brown by the same hand. its whole identification rested on being the matched half of the portrait beside it — and that man has turned out to be an imotski josip, not the crikvenica one. so this is very probably his wife and of the same branch, but this archive is not going to name her a second time on the strength of the reasoning that failed the first. unidentified until someone who holds the originals says otherwise. (open)
from family collection — branch now uncertain
the grave of ana de franceschi

a standing stone with a cross and two oval porcelain medallions — a woman, and a man in a fedora. «ovdje počiva u miru božjem — ana de. franceschi — ✱ 19.ix.1863 ✝ 28.v.1936». here rests in god's peace. below the dates the word «suprug», husband, begins a second inscription that the photograph cuts off.
from family collection (crikvenica)
ursula, born kovačina

anton rudolf's wife, and the mother of the four brothers who ended up in württemberg. seated, in the loose drop-waisted dress of the early 1920s, something folded in her lap. the print is worn to the emulsion at every corner.
ursula in old age, with a grandchild

colour, 1960s or 70s. she sits among stacked café chairs at the edge of a street or square (no sea shows in the frame), a small child standing against her knee, a traffic policeman in white passing behind. the child is not named here.
a studio portrait in a double-breasted pinstripe. set this beside the photograph clipped to his french camp card in 1947 and it is plainly the same man: the same long jaw, the same swept hair.
“peter (senior), pilot in war”

a young man in a leather flying helmet with the goggles pushed up on his forehead, and a sheepskin-collared flying jacket. the family's own caption calls him peter senior, a pilot in the war. nothing in the displaced-persons file mentions flying: there he is a ship's engineer with jugoslav lloyd, and then a motor mechanic.
a studio portrait in a wide-lapelled pinstripe suit, hair oiled back — the same face as the french camp card of 1947, a few years and a good deal of trouble apart.
zdravko's plaque at horsham

«in loving remembrance of zdravko frank defranceski — died 22nd december 1979 aged 58 — beloved husband of rosa» — and then his two children and his four grandchildren, who are living and are not named here — «resting in god's loving care.» a bronze plaque set flush in a concrete surround in a lawn cemetery in the victorian wimmera, for a man born on the kvarner. aged 58 in december 1979 puts his birth in 1921, which is the year the family gives. this is the camera original, four times the size of the copy that was in the family tree file: the founder's mark in the bottom right corner, «c2110», is now legible.
from family collection
a young woman with a flower pinned in her hair, photographed in the 1940s. born at fužine on 13 february 1922; died 30 january 1996 and buried at horsham beside zdravko.
the grave of ivan defrančeski, 1925–1995

polished dark granite, a gilt cross, a lantern, and the name in gilt letters in croatian orthography: ivan defrančeski, and beneath it 1925 and 1995. the dates are now legible — the copy this site had before was 400 pixels wide and they were not. the slab immediately behind is a rukavina, a senj and lika name. the boy who entered a reutlingen factory at sixteen in october 1941 went home, and is buried on his own coast; his son's birth certificate of 1951, also on this page, gives his trade as electro-mechanic and his citizenship as stateless.

the child written on the french camp card in 1947 with the single word «enfant» across the fingerprint boxes, and photographed that year in his mother's arms. here he is a few years older, in a dark pinafore over a knitted jumper. the print is creased or torn from the top edge down through the hair. he died at ipswich, queensland, in 1999.
pepe, centre, with four sailors
five young men in naval ratings' uniform and round caps, shoulder to shoulder against a hedge. the family caption puts pepe in the middle. interwar, and the adriatic: these are yugoslav navy caps.
pepe on the sea wall
a man in shirtsleeves sitting on a harbour parapet, a bay and a low waterfront behind him, boats out on the water. the photographer's blindstamp in the corner reads zora.
stancija seghetto — the manor house

the front giorgio de franceschi (1788–1865) commissioned in 1843–45: two giant pilasters flanking the centre, two orders of six windows, a great round-arched portal, and a tympanum over all. neoclassical, in the manner of the second quarter of the nineteenth century, grafted onto a venetian country house of the seventeenth.
from family collection (seget)
the arms in the tympanum

a circular medallion set in the pediment, with a shield carved in relief inside it, and below, lozenge panels with rosettes. la voce del popolo records the arms here as «troncato di azzurro e d'oro al leone rampante al naturale». at this resolution the carving cannot be read as heraldry — the shape of a shield is legible and nothing inside it is. a proper photograph would settle it.
the crenellated tower

«la torre con merlature, ubicata a nord-ovest rispetto alla casa dominicale» — the battlemented tower north-west of the manor, built to watch the property, and badly restored at the end of the twentieth century. it stands at the roadside with a vine over its shoulder.
the rustic range behind the house

arcaded outbuildings in bad repair: the coach house, the produce stores and the colonists' dwellings. the nineteenth-century oil mill stood among these, with its presses and a dozen stone oil jars, until it was converted into a house about twenty years ago.
a stone wellhead with an iron arch over it, in what is now a garden. the whole holding was walled, and this stood inside it.
the mione birth index, 1806–1810

«dipartimento di passariano, distretto di tolmezzo, cantone di rigolato, comune di mione — tavola alfabetica per gli atti di nascita ch'ebbero luogo dall'anno 1806 all'anno 1810.» the first two lines of the alphabet are defranceschi anna-maria and defranceschi anna-cecilia; de franceschi gio: batta is written in small between the third and fourth lines. four erman entries follow a few lines down — the other family named in the headmen's list of 1679.
from archivio di stato di udine, stato civile napoleonico, mione, sig. 12954
anna maria de franceschi, muina, 30 december 1809

act 32, the last of the year. the midwife speranza, wife of antonio galante, aged fifty-nine, of muina, presented a girl born that morning at eleven, named anna maria — daughter of «osvaldo de franceschi e di appolonia galante sua consorte, ambedue agricoltori domiciliati in esso villaggio». registrar: giacomo micoli.
from archivio di stato di udine, stato civile napoleonico, mione, nati 1809
anna cecilia de' franceschi, mione, 14 january 1810

act 1 of 1810. «francesco de' franceschi d'anni ventisei circa, di professione sarto» — a tailor, aged about twenty-six — brought his daughter, born that morning at three, and named her anna cecilia; her mother is «margherita nata gortan sua consorte». he signs the register himself. act 2 below names pasqua de' franceschi, wife of pietro luchin of mione.
from archivio di stato di udine, stato civile napoleonico, mione, nati 1810
giovanni battista de franceschi, mione, 15 october 1810

act 21. «de franceschi osualdo d'anni ventisei, di professione fa legname» — a carpenter — presented his son, born at ten that morning in the contrada of mione, and named him gio: batta. the mother is «cattarina nata brencis sua consorte». witnesses: a shoemaker and a tailor, both of luint. he signs.
the mione marriage index, 1806–1810

two de franceschi marriages in one small book. the first line of the alphabet: «galante appolonia con defranceschi osualdo — di muina — 28 gennajo 1808». further down: «prencis valentina con defranceschi osualdo — di mione — 6 agosto 1807».
from archivio di stato di udine, stato civile napoleonico, mione, sig. 12987
osvaldo de franceschi marries appolonia galante, 28 january 1808

the deepest document in this archive. osvaldo de franceschi, farmer, aged twenty, of muina, «figlio di antonio de franceschi, e di maria nata corva, pure agricoltori», marries appolonia galante, aged twenty-five and a half, daughter of antonio galante and speranza née micoli. his birth act is read out: born 14 march 1788 at muina, «da legittimo matrimonio di antonio qm. leonardo de franceschi, e di maria nata corva» — antonio, son of the late leonardo. his father's written consent is dated 25 october 1807. four witnesses, three of them micoli of muina. both spouses sign.
from archivio di stato di udine, stato civile napoleonico, mione, matrimoni 1808, atto 1
giacoma de franceschi marries, 7 august 1806

the earliest de franceschi act found in carnia. at mione, in the «distretto della carnia, cantone di gorto», giacoma de franceschi — seventeen years, two months and twelve days old, «figlia del fu osualdo de franceschi, e di catterina nata fabris» — marries ignazio di prato, a merchant of chialina. her birth act of 25 may 1789 is read into the record. she signs herself «giacoma de franceschi q.m osualdo». all four witnesses are tailors; the registrar is giovanni micoli-toscano and the secretary battà micoli-toscano.
from archivio di stato di udine, stato civile napoleonico, mione, matrimoni 1806
the mione death index, 1806–1810

eight defranceschi entries: maria 1807, lucia and francesco antonio 1808, leonarda 1808, anna cecilia in january 1810 eleven days after her birth, sebastiano «chierico» in july 1810, maddalena in august and mariana in september. corva and erman entries stand among them.
from archivio di stato di udine, stato civile napoleonico, mione, sig. 12966
the parish certificate of 1806, reaching back to 1789

filed with the marriage as an allegato, under a two-and-sixpence revenue stamp of the kingdom of italy: «certifico io sottoscritto parroco della pieve matrice di gorto a parte luvincis, come giacoma figlia legitima e naturale di osualdo quondam gio: batta de' franceschi di mione, e di cattarina sua moglie, essa è nata li 25 del mese di maggio nell'anno 1789, come consta dal libro dei battezzi.» signed and sealed by d. gio: batta dario, pievano, at luincis on 5 august 1806, and countersigned at mione by the mayor giovanni micoli-toscano.
from archivio di stato di udine, stato civile napoleonico, mione, matrimoni allegati 1806
a notary's extract from chialina, 8 september 1805

catterina, widow of the late gio: giacomo di prato of chialina, could not attend the signing of the marriage contract between her son ignazio and «giacoma figlia di d.no osualdo de' franceschi di mione», so she appeared before the notary and declared her assent. drawn by antonio di prato, notary. note the style given to giacoma's father: dominus. the date is written «8. 7bre», that is 8 september; the marriage act of 1806 cites the consent as «otto settembre 1805».
yugoslav nationals resident at reutlingen

not the pfullingen list, but the town's own: «liste der im stadtgebiet reutlingen mit betzingen und sondelfingen wohnhaft gewesenen jugoslavischen staatsangehörigen». line 16 is defranceski felix, born 14.1.08 at crikvenica, present from 15 august 1941 to 8 october 1942. read the lines around him: brozicevic, car, three domijans and dracic, every one of them born at crikvenica, arriving from october 1938.
from arolsen archives, de its 2.1.3.1 bw 029 7 jug zm
petar decides to stay — the counselling card, 1949–51

a resettlement counselling card for peter and luise defranceski, iro 148.902, at neuhausen, the street typed on the card as «kellterstrasse 30». three lines under exposé settle what became of the plan to go to california. 22 july 1949: «veut rester en allemagne, a une maison, 2 autos etc.» — wants to stay in germany, has a house, two cars. 28 april 1951: confirms the family wish to remain. 25 may 1951: listed among displaced persons living privately.
from arolsen archives, its 3.1.1.1, folder dp0758
petar's camp card — the original

the same fiche individuelle the family holds as a faint photocopy, here in the original: the clipped passport photograph legible, the five fingerprints in red, «auto-mecancien», kelterstr. 30 neuhausen, file 148.902 cb and 30609.
felix's sickness-fund card — the green original

the allgemeine ortskrankenkasse membership and benefit card in its original green, stamped document exploité. felix defranceski, born 14.1.08 at ericvenica, single, of reutlingen, pfullingerlandstraße. four employments between july 1941 and october 1942, three of them for hermann sauer.
from arolsen archives, its 2.2.2.1 war time card file
the pfullingen list, with the dates readable

the same list of 10 march 1947 the family holds, but the arolsen original. six defranceski with their arrival and departure dates: felix from 5 july 1941; ivan from 20 october 1941 to 5 september 1942; anton, born 20.1.90, from 1 march to 13 june 1942 only; zdravko from 17 june 1944; ruža of fužine from 29 july 1944. felix, zdravko and ruža all leave on the same day — 3 march 1945.
from arolsen archives, de its 2.1.3.1, its 154
the neuhausen list, 25 march 1947

drawn up under general koenig's order no. 1792: every foreigner in the commune of neuhausen an der erms between september 1939 and april 1945. the first seven names are one family. peter from 22 march 1941; luise née salzer, born in the village, «seit geburt»; the daughters ursula and renate likewise; and zdravko, rose née hreljec of fužine/belnica, and the infant anton, all from 19 march 1945.
from arolsen archives, de its 2.1.3.1, its 157
the omiš descent chart

a typeset, boxed chart headed «rodoslovno stablo obitelji franceschi» (the omiš and zadar family), twenty generations deep, running from the fourteenth century to the twentieth. the later generations are omitted from this archive because the people in them may be living: the top tiers of the chart, from those born after 1946, are blanked out in this image.
defranceschi at bakar, 1783

a strip of a register page kept with the family's research notes: four partial lines beginning «die 10 9bris» and a folio number. no name, year or place can be read on this image, so what it shows does not itself place the name at bakar in 1783; that rests on the family's note.
from family research collection

gologorica under its italian name — moncalvo in the county of pazin, where carlo de franceschi was born in 1809. the picture is a printed pen drawing of the house, headed «casa de franceschi in moncalvo»: an arched loggia, an outside stair and three figures in the courtyard.
the western-istrian estate of the other branch, which reached istria from crete after the candian war ended in 1669.
petar's fiche individuelle, with his photograph

the french occupation authorities' individual card. nationality yougoslav, born 15.06.13, profession auto-mecancien, address kelterstr. 30 neuhausen, married. card 30609; the number written across the head is 148.902 cb bj. five fingerprints in red ink, and a passport photograph: dark jacket, dark tie, hair combed back. under vaccins, in a clerk's hand: tetanus once, typhus twice.
from arolsen archives, dp folder dp0758 (03010101 05 070)
the counselling card, front

headed counselling in a red box. defranceski, peter and luise; iro 148.902; category cb; born 15.6.13 yougoslavie (cirkvenica) and 5.10.19. address, as at 1 april 1951: kellterstrasse 30, neuhaus kr. reutlingen. under other members of the family, the wife and two children with their birth dates. three lines under expose, dated 22.7.49, 28.4.51 and 25.5.51 — he wants to stay, he confirms it, and he is entered on the list of displaced persons living privately.
the counselling card, reverse

two columns, date and interventions, and one line written in them: 30.7.49 — «proposons a mr. boesch de le mettre «bj»». eight days after petar told the counsellor he had a house and two cars and meant to stay, the office proposed to reclassify him off iro care.
the card that gives the day they left

reutlingen, 148.901. defranceski, anton 22.8.44 youg., a household of three, category cb. in ink across the middle: «emigre australie le 8.3.49», with 17.3.49 beneath it. at the foot, a red stamp: cm/1 destroyed — which is why no care-and-maintenance file survives for zdravko's family, and why his brother has one.

reutlingen, 148.902. «defranceski, luise 5.10.19 apatr.» — apatride, stateless; a household of four; category bj. she was born german at neuhausen in the reutlingen district, and on marrying a yugoslav in february 1942 took his nationality and lost her own. one abbreviated word is the whole of her legal position.
petar's index card at reutlingen

reutlingen, 148.902. defranceski, petar 15.6.13 youg., a household of four, category cb. beneath, in four hands: «c.v. 15.12.45»; «73-(102) re. 1, b. rev. 1./10.7.49»; «tit 1165, 11.8.49, bj»; «03.tr.16, «bj» 23.8.49». the reclassification going through the books, one office at a time.
stamped 16 october 1951

the same printed form as his brother's child's card, filled for the man himself and stamped in red: 16 okt 1951, iro. the place of birth is written in by hand beside the typed date — crikvenica. marked bj and cb across the head.
zdravko's fiche individuelle, with his photograph

card 30560, iro 148.901. defranceski zdravko, yougoslav, born 01.04.21, auto-mecanicien. the address line is blank on this card. five fingerprints in red and a small photograph: dark jacket, hair combed back, the same studio hand as his brother's. arolsen's own copy of this household's file is stamped cm/1 destroyed; the family kept theirs.
from family collection — the reutlingen file
zdravko's displaced-person identity card

commandement en chef francais en allemagne, issued 27 november 1946. height 175, brown eyes, chestnut hair; profession auto-mecanicien; married. the red-pencil note «8/3/1949 australie» that this file carries is not visible on this view of the card.
ruza, with anton on her arm

card 30561. the photograph pasted to ruza's fiche individuelle shows her holding the baby — the same child whose own card, a few numbers along, has the word enfant written across the fingerprint boxes in red crayon.
ruza's identity card, with the child

issued 27 november 1946 at neuhausen, «friedrichstr. 2» as it reads on this card. born 13 february 1922 at fusine, yugoslavia; married. the photograph is of mother and child together. the note «8/3/1949 austr.» is not visible on this view of the card.
the letter that explains the code

27 may 1949, from a. poignant, director of the iro for the french zone, to the chef de service du wurtemberg at ebingen. subject: «cas de defranceski (148.902)». eligibility verified on 15.12.48 — and then the sentence the whole file turns on: «le chef de famille et les deux enfants sont classes b, l'epouse bj.»

a small green slip signed by dr s. birietaite, chef de service de sante: «m. defranceski est passe au screening — bresil», and beneath in blue, «rien a signaler». he passed the medical for brazil. he did not go.
zdravko's reutlingen certificate, 1950

stadt pfullingen, kreis reutlingen, stamped 28 february 1950: defranceski «ztravko» as typed, born 1.4.21 at «zvekveniza» (crikvenica), croatian-yugoslav, resident pfullingen, employer hermann sauer, reutlingen-sud.
ruza's reutlingen certificate, 1950

the same form, the same day: defranceski rose geb. hreljac, born «13.222» at «fuzina/debnice» as typed, resident pfullingen; the employer line is blank on this copy. her birthplace is given here with its district — the fullest form the archive has.
il giovine pensiero, pola, 16 january 1895

front page. the stenographic record of the opening of the provincial diet of istria at parenzo. the provincial captain gives the floor to «l'on. giovanni battista de franceschi, che a nome della maggioranza intera cosi si esprime» — and the speech that follows protests to the imperial government at the treatment of the italians of istria. further down the same page, among the bills before the session: the establishment of new local communes at pisino, novacco, lindaro, terviso, gallignana and pedena.
from osterreichische nationalbibliothek, anno — igp18950116
the same issue, page two

the motions and their signatories. g. b. de franceschi signs the interpellation on the missing vice-president and dr bubba's motion against the bilingual signs in the istrian district courts. later he acts as teller in the election of a substitute assessor, and speaks again for the majority asking the captain to talk the resigning assessors into staying.
l'eco di pola, 14 january 1893, page two

carlo de franceschi's career obituary, six days after his death at gologorica. it gives the reason he lost his post — «venne cassato dal ruolo degli impiegati e messo in quiescenza per sospetti politici», struck off the roll of officials and pensioned off on suspicion of political sympathies, in 1854 — and lists what he left unpublished: a volume of memoirs and an unfinished study on the nationality of istria. the memoirs waited thirty-three years for his son camillo to print them.
from osterreichische nationalbibliothek, anno — edp18930114
il giovine pensiero, 18 january 1893, front page

two things on one page. top left, the life: «nacque a moncalvo (gollogorizza) il 17 ottobre 1810 da famiglia abbastanza agiata» — a birth date ten days after his death that disagrees with the 16 october 1809 the reference books give, and the only contemporary word this archive holds on the standing of the household. right-hand columns, the letter from pisino signed don ramiro: «sor carlo» on a saturday in the fountain square, surrounded by the poor of the commune, handing out alms and staying to talk.
from osterreichische nationalbibliothek, anno — igp18930118
nasa sloga, 25 march 1909, front page

the croatian paper of istria answering the italian side with the italian side's own book. middle of the page: «mjesta gologorica, cernogradus i bellegradus spominju se u listini od 1102 (v. de franceschi str. 351.)» — the places gologorica, cernogradus and bellegradus are named in a charter of 1102, see de franceschi page 351. carlo had cited those same three names to argue the slavs arrived late. nasa sloga cites them to argue the croats were there first. the family's village is the first exhibit in both cases.
from osterreichische nationalbibliothek, anno — nsp19090325
nasa sloga, 13 april 1900, page two

a false lead, kept because a negative result is a result. among the local notices: «nacelnikom u umagu bijase izabran dne 9. t. mj. g. fr. de franceschi, bivsi nacelnik one obcine» — a fr. de franceschi elected mayor of umag on 9 april 1900, having held the office before. umag is at the far western tip of istria, ninety kilometres from gologorica, and nothing yet connects him to this family.
from osterreichische nationalbibliothek, anno — nsp19000413
il giovine pensiero, 26 july 1894, page two

correspondence datelined moncalvo, dist. di pisino, 24 july. the amateur band and many townspeople of pisino came out on the sunday, invited by the whole village, to the birthplace of carlo de franceschi. two stones, apparently thrown from the bell tower, smashed the flower vase the village women had brought and crushed a trumpet; at half past eight the band tried to leave and was set on at the village exit by about ten men with stones and drawn blades. fifteen wounded. the two hurt worst were carried into the peschle house and the defranceschi house, and four gendarmes came out from pisino that night with the district doctor. the paper records, twice, that the communal representative ivic was the same man who had refused burial to carlo's body the year before -- and that none of the attackers was a native of moncalvo.
from osterreichische nationalbibliothek, anno — igp18940726
il giovine pensiero, 15 june 1895, page three

the trial of the band night, taken down witness by witness. right-hand column: «entra vittorio defranceschi fu francesco, gollogorizza d'anni 23» -- vittorio defranceschi, son of the late francesco, of gologorica, aged twenty-three, so born about 1872. he appears in other men's evidence as well. the shouts the court was trying to fix were «crepa i taliani, bastonemoli» and «zivio», and the advocate dr trinajstic addressed the bench in croatian.
from osterreichische nationalbibliothek, anno — igp18950615
the builder's tablet, on the front of the house

a plain rectangular panel of pale limestone set flush into the whitewashed wall under a moulded cornice, its cut letters shallow and raked by flat light. this is the stone that reads anno · domni · 1711 / gion · batista / de · franceschi / fecce · fare · pe[r] · se / et · heredi · svoi — the year carlo gave kobler privately in about 1873, cut in the wall of the house.
from photographed by the family at gologorica, 2026
the de franceschi family slab at gologorica, under a shield

a tall marble slab with a triangular pediment carrying a crowned shield with a cross, arrows and a pomegranate, headed «famiglia de franceschi» and cut in roman capitals for three people: virginia fu carlo (fiume 1858 – parenzo 1876), maria micheli, wife of carlo (pisino 1828 – parenzo 1880), and pietro fu carlo, magistrate (rovigno 1854 – moncalvo 1884). the inscription this plate was captioned for — «in questa casa avita nacque e morì», patriotta fervente, archeologo e storico, mdcccix–mdcccxciii — is not on this slab.
the arms, and the madonna beneath them

the two carvings in one frame, as they sit on the façade: above, an oval cartouche in high relief with curling mantling and a plumed helm; below it an aedicule with scrolled volutes and a moulded cornice, framing a marble relief of a haloed woman with her arms flung wide and drapery falling around her. around the rim of the oval runs a circular legend of which «…a · de · franceschi · fieri…» survives.
the blazon, cut in stone on the tomb

in the pediment of the family tomb, a shield under a coronet: a cross rising the height of the field, crossed diagonally by two straight shafts, with a pomegranate in the lower field beneath them. set this beside what carlo wrote to giovanni kobler in about 1873 — «nella parte superiore dello scudo una croce greca attraversata da due frecce, nell'inferiore un pomo granato; sopra lo scudo un elmo piumato». the description and the carving agree.
the same arms, worn almost away

an older stone in the same ground, its oval field weathered nearly smooth, with the cross and the crossing shafts still legible and something round below them where the pomegranate should be. two carvings of one blazon, a century or more apart, on two stones in the same cemetery.
the family tomb at gologorica

a tall stone monument with a cross on its gable, a panelled front of veined marble between pilasters, a round medallion in the gable, and a small shield on each of the two tablets either side. this is the plot for which the architect giuseppe hirsch drew a «cappella della famiglia di carlo de franceschi nel cimitero di moncalvo di pisino», the rolled plan for which is still in the zagreb archive boxes.
the house, from the lane

a long white block of two and three storeys under a tiled roof carried on projecting wooden brackets, with a tall chimney of dressed stone and a palm in front of it. radmila matejčić described this building in 1979 from the outside — «il proprio palazzetto con portico ad arcate e blasone sulla facciata» — and this archive took her word for it for a year before the family went and photographed it.
the arcaded end, and the steps up to it

the near end of the house: two round arches on stone piers, a stone balustrade, and a flight of steps rising to the loggia from the lane. this is matejčić's «portico ad arcate», and the red-and-white enamel plate on the wall between the arches gives the address — number 22.
a carved ring, in the tomb wall
a raised circular moulding cut proud of a smooth panel, carved as a serpent biting its tail, with a patch of orange lichen at its foot. it reads as the setting for something now gone.
a niche in the cemetery wall
a small pedimented recess of white stone set into rough coursed masonry, holding a cross carved with leaves and two small potted plants.
a small whitewashed chapel with a bellcote, standing among the graves at gologorica.
soravito de franceschi, on a stone at ovaro

a polished slab with two oval portrait medallions: «sebastiano soravito de franceschi ✻1889 ✝1958» and beneath him «anna crosilla ved. soravito de franceschi ✻1900 ✝1990». the byname this archive first met as a puzzle in a family tree is cut in stone in the valley the family came out of — and crosilla is one of the carnian surnames that travelled to istria beside it.
from photographed by the family in carnia, 2026
de franceschi ugo, 1930–2020

a photograph behind glass and the name cut below it: «de franceschi ugo, 24.11.1930 – 4.6.2020», with a lamp burning in front. the surname is not a memory in these valleys. it was buried here five years ago.
«de franceschi antonio — marta anzola — figli e figlie»
a dark stone with one oval medallion at the head holding a photograph of the two together: antonio, 1860–1942, and marta anzola, 1875–1964. the last line names the sons and daughters who put it up.
teresa comuzzi and gio. batta de franceschi

one marble slab on a stone wall, with a portrait for each and a relief of the virgin and child between them: «teresa comuzzi 1886–1963» and «gio. batta de franceschi 1880–1963». giovanni battista is the name at the head of the istrian house too — the one on the 1711 tablet — and here it is still in use in carnia into the twentieth century.
francesco de franceschi, 1887–1945
a weathered slab, water-streaked, with two portraits: «francesco de franceschi 1887–1945» and «liduina cecconi 1897–1977».
an older stone, and the name cut deep

a block of grey stone, the lettering shallow and lichened, with «…de franceschi» legible across it with a birth year of 1833 and a death in the 1890s. the oldest de franceschi stone the family photographed in the valley.
two of the name on the war memorial

a marble tablet, «in memoria dei caduti in guerra», in two columns. among them «de franceschi vittorio» and «de franceschi isidoro», with micoli, spinotti, stefani, lorenzini and fabris — the same dozen surnames that run through every document in these villages, and through the carnian settlements in istria.
the tower of the pieve, above the graves

the romanesque campanile of santa maria di gorto standing over the cemetery under a grey sky. this is the mother church of the val degano — the pieve whose two parishes, ovaro and luincis, drew up the return of 1679 that names «zuane de franceschi con un suo fiolo» among the men gone to istria.
pieve di santa maria di gorto — the interpretation board
the public board at the church, in italian and friulian: «pieve di santa maria di gorto / plef di sante marie di guart».
the big house in the valley

a tall rendered house of three storeys with a green hipped roof, red shutters and a garden in front, seen through foliage, with hills behind. photographed by the family on the road through ovaro and mione.
«f de franceschi» at gračišće

a pale slab headed f de franceschi, with two portrait medallions beneath: «marfan virginija ✻30.iii.1895 ✝28.xii.1981» and «nazarijo ✻7.02.1939 ✝11.12.2003». a red lamp stands at the foot. the surname is on the ground in the parish where the direct line held houses 5 and 19.
from photographed by the family at gračišće, 2026
the salamon, in the same cemetery

«coniugi» — spouses — with rosa ivich and silvio salamon and their son ottavio salamon, and below them «salamon bruno 1928–1996». generation two of the direct line married a francisca salamon, born 17 march 1797, in 1819; this archive has never had anything on her but a name and a palace on the square. here is the family still in the ground at gračišće a hundred and eighty years later.
«genitori, fratello e sorelle posero»

«f. marfan — mafalda ✻3.ii.1928 ✝17.xi.1974 — ivan ✻23.viii.1904 ✝28.ii.1986», and at the foot the line that says who put the stone up: the parents, the brother and the sisters. marfan is one of the surnames standing beside defranceschi in the gračišće ground.
the other family's arms, in painted ironwork

a lunette of wrought iron over the tomb at umag: black scrollwork with silver highlights around a coroneted shield bearing a lion rampant with a star beside it, against ochre stone. set it beside the gologorica blazon — a cross crossed by two arrows over a pomegranate — and the point makes itself. two families of one surname in one province, and they never used each other's arms.
from photographed by the family at umag, 2026
«famiglia de franceschi — seghetto»
the tomb front, in a plain classical frame: the family name, and beneath it the place — seghetto, the italian form of seget. the estate the venier sold them in 1720.
«famiglia ettore de franceschi»
a small white plaque with a cross, fixed to a rough stone wall in the cemetery. ettore is the name of the de franceschi who wrote with giulio cervani on depopulation in venetian istria.
a de franceschi family slab at umag

a tall white marble slab, streaked with dirt, with raised lettering for five people, each «de franceschi»: francesca (aged 77, died 1924), rag. giorgio (26, died 4 february 1940), ing. italo (68, died 3 december 1944), teramondo (74, died 12 december 1945) and, widow, fragiacomo anna (70, died 27 august 1960). the slab with a don antonio and the date «morto 12.iii.1848» that this plate was captioned for is not what this image shows; no 1848 appears on it.

a long three-storey block of dressed stone with a pedimented centre and a rusticated ground floor, standing behind parked cars under a wet sky. this is the building petar puhmajer surveyed for «stancija de franceschi u segetu kod umaga».
from photographed by the family at seget, 2026
the tomb at umag, whole
a classical aedicule of pale stone with paired columns, a semicircular lunette of blue and gilt ironwork above, and a low iron rail in front, with clipped box either side of the steps.
a pine cone, and a wreath

the crown of the tomb: a carved pine cone finial above a lunette holding a stone wreath with a rosette at its head and the date 1890 cut in the roundel at its centre. the pine cone is an old emblem of regeneration and it is common on adriatic funerary work.
«obitelj defranceski»

a dark polished stone headed obitelj defranceski — the defranceski family — with three oval portrait medallions set into it: two men and a woman, photographed in their middle age. the croatian spelling, on the coast the household came down to.
from photographed by the family on the kvarner coast, 2026
marija kalanj, 1889–1970

a plain grey slab with a portrait medallion and a cross: «marija kalanj 1889–1970». anton rudolf's mother was ana kalanj, born at klenovica house 22 on 3 january 1864 — and this ground is full of her name.
«obitelj kalanj» — josip, franjo, zora

three medallions on one stone: «josip 1950–1983», «franjo 1909–1991», «zora 1923–1999». zora is also the name of the defranceschi girl born at crikvenica in december 1896 who turns up nursing the wounded there in march 1915.
«obitelj kalanj» — rozalija, anton, marija, milan
a pale slab with four names cut in a column and a white vase of flowers at the head of it.
kalanj vinko and kalanj paulina
letters cut into a polished dark stone: «kalanj vinko 1901–1961» and «kalanj paulina 1904–1984», with a spray of flowers laid against it.
the star, in the cemetery

a five-pointed star laid in white stone on a bed of rubble among the graves, photographed at dusk. the partisan memorial in a coastal cemetery — the other side of the winter this archive cannot yet document, when anton rudolf was taken.
house 24: the midwife, her sons, and the eleven children

a page of the gračišće status animarum photographed from the reading-room screen at the državni arhiv u pazinu. three households under the number 24. the first is headed «maria defranceschi n. fernazar», her condition given as obstetrix — midwife — born 17-10-1832, married 25-11-1856, died 10-1-1916, with antonius (murator, mason), josephus, modestus and catharina under her. the second is antonius q. antonii and «maria n. volhardt eius uxor», and beneath them eleven children in one column.
from photographed by the family at the državni arhiv u pazinu, 2026
the same page, lower: daniel's household

the foot of the same page. «daniel defranceschi q. antonii», agricola, born 8-3-1905 and married 2-7-1927, with «paula n. criavaz eius uxor», born 19-7-1905, and six children after them running from dionysius in 1927 to maria-gratia in 1943, with a further line, maria-euphemia, marked «filia», below them. one of them, josephus, is born 25-6-1941 and dead 15-5-1942, with both dates in the same hand.
ivan's birth certificate, and the word «stateless»

a sworn english translation of the yugoslav extract from the register of births — region senj, national board of senj municipality, reg. 152/1954. it records defranceski ivan, male, born 17 december 1951 at 11h50 in senj hospital, entered on 22 december 1951 at page 252, ordinal number 110. the father is defranceski ivan, born 25 june 1925 at crikvenica, an electro-mechanic — and his citizenship is given as stateless and his nationality as italian, while the mother, blazevic hedviga, born 3 august 1926 at senj, is fnrj and croatian. certified by marijana cizek, sworn translator for the supreme court of south africa.
giovanni battista defranceschi marries at bakar, 20 november 1772

the second entry on the left-hand page: «die 20 9bris per dispensationem [d]omi[nicalem] nuptijs in facie ecclesiae contractis inter d. joannem bapt. filium d. francisci defranceschi et catharinam filiam def[uncti] antonij akacich benedixit d. can[onicu]s georgius akacich, praesentibus ill[ustrissi]mo dd. antonio viviani vicario et fiscali et andrea zergolech» — on 20 november, by dispensation, a marriage contracted in the face of the church between dominus giovanni battista, son of dominus francesco defranceschi, and catharina, daughter of the late antonio akačić; blessed by canon georgius akačić, in the presence of the most illustrious antonio viviani, vicar and fiscal, and andrea zergolech. the bride’s surname is hard on the page; the familysearch index of the same volume reads it akacich, and the canon who blessed the marriage carries it too, so a priest of her own family married her. the year is fixed by the page: the right-hand column closes the register with a ruled line and «anno 1773».
from matične knjige, bakar (buccari) — supplied by the family, 2026
the blažević grave at senj, read at last

a limestone panel set in a heavy moulded frame in the senj cemetery wall, photographed in 2019 in soft even light — which is why it reads, where the 2026 frame in flat sun did not. «ljubomir blažević ✻ 1891 † 1966 · milka blažević rođ. papić ✻ 1886 † 1971 · oto blažević ✻ 1923 † 1945 · mario blažević ✻ 1933 † 1984», and on a dark plate fixed below, «blažević — kata ✻ 1924 † 2007 · leo ✻ 1920 † 2008». behind it stand the newer black monuments of the row: frane rogić, vukelić, augustin and anđo tomljanović, vladimir bezjak.
from photographed by the family at senj, 5 june 2019
the campanile of santa maria di gorto

the leaning fourteenth-century bell tower of the pieve of santa maria di gorto, above the graves. this is the mother church of the whole canale di gorto — the valley the carnian families went to istria from — and everyone on this page is buried at its foot.
from photographed by the family at the cemetery of santa maria di gorto, ovaro, october 2026
the graveyard at gorto
looking across the cemetery to the church and the mountain. some thirty stones here carry the surname or a de franceschi mother.

guerra 1940 - 1945. militari caduti: spinotti adolfo, spinotti ervisio. dispersi: de franceschi isidoro, macuglia donato, menegon aniceto, micoli sisto. civili caduti 1 e 2. xi. 1944: stradiotto angelina, de franceschi egidio, fabris geom. giovanni, fabris tullio, felice guido, gallo ettore, micoli elio. cut at the foot: f. f. 19-9-1954.
pustetto and de franceschi, six in one stone

ins. mario furlani - albona 1912, ovaro 1978
a schoolmaster's tablet: ins. mario furlani, albona 1912, ovaro 1978. born at albona - labin, in istria - and dead in the carnian valley the migration set out from. the road ran both ways.
soravito de franceschi

sebastiano soravito de franceschi 1852-1936 and maria roia in soravito de franceschi 1856-1930, with giacomina soravito 1886-1967 below; figli dolenti posero. the surname has been taken into the soravito name and carried as part of it.

sebastiano soravito de franceschi 1889-1958 and anna crosilla ved. soravito de franceschi 1900-1990. crosilla is one of the four carnian surnames the literature follows into istria alongside this one.
agostino and francesco de franceschi
a weathered upright, the upper inscription almost gone: agostino de franceschi above, and cut in raised letters at the foot francesco de franceschi 1887 - 1945, with a bearded portrait.
francesco de franceschi and liduina cecconi

francesco de franceschi 1887-1945 and liduina cecconi 1897-1977, with two porcelain portraits - the same stone as the worn one shown before it (the plate «francesco de franceschi, 1887–1945»), not a second memorial: liduina's name is cut beneath francesco's, under the almost-effaced older inscription.

de franceschi lucia 1890-1970 and mirai igino 1888-1972, in gilt letters on grey granite, with portraits, a lamp and flowers.
de franceschi vittorio
de franceschi vittorio, 26 january 1927 - 6 july 2006, with a framed photograph above the stone.

rovis gio batta 1841-1892 - giorgis caterina 1840-1919 - rovis faustino 1874-1956 - de franceschi amalia 1886-1964 - rovis guido 1907-1975. rovis of gimino and giorgis of san pietro in selve are two of the carnian houses that settled in istria; here they are married to this one, at home.
de franceschi maria teresa, widow fiorencis

de franceschi maria teresa ved. fiorencis 1913-2001, and beneath it the words mandi miuta, with i tuoi cari cut on the base. fiorencis is another of the carnian surnames recorded in the svetvincenat household book of 1734.
corva marianna and de franceschi umberto
corva marianna 1896-1979 and de franceschi umberto, in gilt on red granite with two portraits. corva is a carnian name that also appears in the sanvincenti court papers in istria.
de franceschi anna, 1925-2022
de franceschi anna, born 22 february 1925, died 5 october 2022 - the most recent burial of the surname in this cemetery, and the reason the name is not a historical one here.
maddalena defranceschi and luigi giorgis
maddalena defranceschi 1875-1951 and luigi giorgis 1875-1950, figli dolenti posero - the surname cut here as two words, de franceschi.
de franceschi lice adami
de franceschi lice adami 1914-2002, with a portrait and a gilt cross.
isabella dell'oste, widow de franceschi
isabella dell'oste ved. de franceschi, born 13 april 1910, died 6 september 1997; i figli ti ricordano, beneath a carved relief of christ and mary.
the hayloft portal of the beorchia-micoli house, muina

a stone barn portal at muina, in the val degano — the village carlo de franceschi named, beside mione, as still holding the family in the 1870s. the house is the beorchia-micoli, and the micoli are the family whose archive at mione holds the gorto contracts naming the erman who travelled to istria with zuane de franceschi in 1679. no claim is made that this is a de franceschi house. it is the architecture of the valley they came from, photographed on the street they walked.
from wikimedia commons · mj6s · public domain
the presbytery at muina

the canonica of muina — the priest's house, and therefore where the parish books were written and kept. the ovaro registers before 1806 are in no portal and must be asked for from the parish; this is the door to ask at.
the bridge at muina, over the degano

muina and mione sit on opposite sides of the degano, seven hundred and eighty-four metres apart. this is the crossing between them — the whole distance between the two villages carlo named in one breath.
from wikimedia commons · verardo giulio · cc by 3.0

agrons, in the val degano — the answer to the question this archive was built to ask. for months the site could say the family came out of carnia and not from where. on 7 september 2026 three independent sources arrived within an hour of each other and gave the same village. this is it under snow.
the same hamlet in leaf. nothing in this picture is a de franceschi house — this archive has not identified one at agrons and would say so if it had. it is the ground the name came off.
from wikimedia commons · mj6s · cc by-sa 3.0
the micoli toscano palace and hayloft, mione

the house that holds the contracts. the micoli toscano family archive at mione keeps the gorto contracts — including the ones naming the erman who travelled to istria with zuane de franceschi in 1679, the single document that shows the journey at all. giacomo micoli was also the registrar who wrote the napoleonic civil acts this archive read in 2026. this is the building.
from wikimedia commons · sebi1 · cc by-sa 3.0
mione, from across the valley
mione di ovaro, in the canale di gorto — the village of the 1679 headmen's return, of the five households of 1806–1810, and of the bishop born there in 1939 who still carried the name.
the porton at gračišće
the gate of gallignana. four generations of this line were born inside this wall — house 5 and then house 19 — between 1787 and 1863, before josip took the family over the mountain to crikvenica.
from wikimedia commons · vid pogačnik · cc by-sa 4.0
klenovica, on the vinodol shore

house 22. anton rudolf defranceski was born here on 20 january 1890, and the register entered him as «gallignana u istriji» — gallignana in istria — twenty-seven years after his father left it. the photograph is a view of the bay and the village from the shore; house 22 cannot be picked out in it.
from wikimedia commons · györgyfi · cc by-sa 3.0
ivan on the shingle, about a year old

a baby sitting unaided on a shore of broken white limestone, bare but for a polka-dot kerchief knotted over his head against the sun, the exposed roots of a tree filling the frame behind him. he is laughing at something off to his right. he can sit up without support and has his front teeth, which puts him at roughly nine to eighteen months. ⚠ the scan's own metadata dates this 31 december 1951, and that cannot be right. ivan was born on 17 december 1951; on 31 december he was fourteen days old. the file's datetimeoriginal reads 1951:12:31 14:00:00 — a round hour on the last day of the year, which is the shape of a date somebody typed to stand for «1951», not one a camera wrote. the filename carries a third answer again, the prefix 1990s_, which is the scanning batch. read from the photograph instead: a warm month, a child of about one — so the summer of 1952, or the summer of 1953 at the latest. (inf, from apparent age and bare skin; the 1951 stamp is rejected.)
from family collection — cheryl's album 2, leaf 209
ivan as a young man, studio portrait

head and shoulders against a studio backdrop graded from pale at the left to dark behind the right shoulder — the standard lighting of a small commercial studio. an open-necked white shirt with a broad soft collar, worn without a tie; dark hair brushed into a heavy wave off the forehead; the beginnings of a moustache. he looks just past the camera. a rust-coloured foxing spot has bloomed on the print at the left collar point, and the white border is trimmed close. undated. the file's timestamp, 19 january 2022, is the date of the scan — there is no camera make or model in it, and the image is a flatbed capture of a paper print. from apparent age alone he is about sixteen to twenty, which would put the sitting somewhere around 1968 to 1971. (inf, and from the face only — no inscription, no studio stamp, nothing on the back has been read.)
from family collection — cheryl's album 4, leaf 69
ivan at sixty, 12 april 2012

a close portrait lit from the left against a dark room, white hair back off the forehead, a white moustache and a small beard under the lip, the skin of the face carrying every line the light can find. he is looking straight into the lens and half-smiling. this one is dated to the minute and the date is the camera's own. the file is dsc_0843, written by a nikon d800 — datetimeoriginal 2012:04:12 07:54:28, f/16, iso 125, 135 mm. (doc: an exif date written by the camera at the moment of capture is evidence in a way a scan's timestamp never is.) he was sixty years and four months old.
luiza defranceski — fiche individuelle

«nom defranceski · prénoms luiza · nationalité youg. · date de naissance 5.10.1919 · profession ménagère · adresse de l'employeur neuhausen, kelterstr. 30 · situation de famille mariée» — iro no. 148.902 b, camp number 31163. she is petar's wife, and the address proves it before the names do. kelterstr. 30 neuhausen is the employer's address on petar defranceski's own fiche. this archive already knew he «married luise salzer at neuhausen in february 1942» — this is that woman, under her married name, with her own date of birth on a card of her own. (doc.)
from arolsen archives
luiza's identity card — and the only picture of the children

carte d'identité de personnes déplacées, commandement en chef français en allemagne, issued 27 november 1946. nom defranceski, prénom lujza, yougoslave, neuhausen, kelterstr. 30, cercle de reutlingen, mariée. her thumbprint in the box, the french zone's stamp across the photograph. handwritten across the head, «pas personne déplacée … allemande mariée yougoslave», and in green, «allemande». in the photograph she is holding two small children. they are named on cards of their own in the same file and they are not named here, because both were born within living memory and this archive does not print a living person's date of birth — not in text and not in a scan of a document that states it. the photograph is published; their two fiches are not.
the letter that let them stay

international refugee organization, zone française d'occupation en allemagne, to the chef de service du wurtemberg. «objet: cas de defranceski … je vous informe que l'éligibilité de l'intéressé a été vérifiée le 15.12.48. le chef de famille et les deux enfants sont classés b, l'épouse bj.» eligibility was the whole question for a displaced person: it decided whether the iro would feed you, house you and resettle you, or whether you were a foreign national who could be sent home. classified on 15 december 1948, and the family stayed. the «deux enfants» are the two children in luiza's photograph. (doc.)
zdravko's identity card, neuhausen 1946

carte d'identité de personnes déplacées, 27 november 1946 — the same day as luiza's. nom defranceski, prénom zdrafko, neuhausen, friedrichstr. 4, cercle de reutlingen, né à crikvenica, yougoslavie, auto-mécanicien, marié. taille 175, visage ovale, yeux bruns, cheveux châtain. two households of the name in one small town: petar and luiza at kelterstr. 30, zdravko and ruža at friedrichstr. 4. zdravko sailed for australia in 1949.
