maria rosalia defranceschi, baptised 20 july 1789

gologorica baptisms, image m01069020. reading across: the officiant «a.r.d. antonius giacich ex abatia»; the day, 20; house 36; «maria rosa=/lia defrances=/chi ex loco»; the father «joh: baptis[ta]»; and, in the parents' surname column, «catharina joblich». the godmother is «rosalia baxa uxor petri, ex lindar» — and the child is named rosalia after her. her death in the 1826 household census, aged 37 years 2 months 10 days, computes back to this exact day. this crop shows only the right-hand columns — the father, the mother's surname and the godparents; the officiant, the day, the house number and the child's own name are in the left-hand columns, which are not on this image.
from državni arhiv u pazinu, microfilm zm34k-214 — the family's own copy of the film
«cath. ejus uxor nata jablich ex buccari», 3 october 1786

gologorica baptisms, image m01069017. joannes baptista defranceschi and his wife stand godparents, and the register names her origin: born a jablich, out of buccari — bakar, on the kvarner, a hundred and thirty kilometres away and under another crown. both are entered «cives gollogoricenses». the surname was read jaklich at page scale; magnified, the letter is the same b as in buccari written beneath it.
«hunc in filium adoptivum accepit patruus leonardus» — house 6, 1826

gologorica status animarum 1826, image m01069328. the name column enters «antonius defranceschi filius usualdi et apoloniæ»; the annotation on the right records that his father's brother leonardus took him as an adopted son and settled him here under number 6. the provenance column gives antonius coming «ex parochia lindaris» and his wife francisca «ex parochia gallignanæ sub n.o 5». this archive had carried antonius as leonardus's own son.
house 1 is the parish house — eight priests of gologorica

gologorica status animarum 1826, image m01069319. the first household of the book is the plebania, kept up into the 1880s: brussich of vrbnik, milcetich of omišalj, zwölber, sajovec, dragovina of pazin, flegar of novaki, fabris of lindar, vitezić of vrbnik — with birth dates, origins, and for two of them the day they died and were buried here. three of the eight came off the island of krk.
the entry itself — house 36, 20 july 1789

gologorica baptisms, image m01069020, left-hand columns. the officiant is «a.r.d. antonius giacich ex abatia»; the day is 20; the house is 36; and the child is «maria rosa=/lia defrances=/chi ex loco», the surname broken across two lines as the column is narrow. the month is blotted, but the entry sits between «9 aprilij» above and «30 julij» below in a run kept in order.
house 7 — the historian's own household, 1826

gologorica status animarum 1826, image m01069332. jacobus defranceschi, civis, born 21 july 1761, dead 3 december 1850 aged 88; then house 7 proper — josephus defranceschi, born 4 march 1765, married 3 february 1807, dead 12 december 1838; «lambertina uxor nata peschle», born 17 september 1786, «ex volosca», dead 16 july 1863 aged 76 years 10 months; and their children, among them «carolus», born 17 october 1809 and dead 8 january 1893 — carlo de franceschi, the historian this archive leans on, in his own parish's household book. this image shows the left-hand page; the death dates and ages quoted here are in the columns of the right-hand page, which this frame does not include.
«dnus josephus defranceschi» and ten children — and aloysius born at volosca

gologorica status animarum 1826, image m01069408. the household of «dnus josephus defranceschi», condition civilitas, born 4 march 1765, married 2 february 1807, with «lambertina uxor nata peschle», born 17 september 1786 — and their ten children, among them «charolus», the historian. the last line reads «aloysius … filius natus volosca» — born at volosca, his mother's own town on the kvarner. this archive had recorded him as «natus polonia», born in poland. nine children are entered in the lines on this image; the tenth, if the title's count is right, is not on it.
the first page of the baptism book — and a defranceschi on it, 6 january 1785

gologorica baptisms 1784–1880, image m01069014, folio 2. the book opens in 1784 with «math: defranceschi ecclesiae hujus gollogoricensis» as the officiating priest — a defranceschi baptising his own parish. the fifth entry is «josephi anton defranceschi ex loco», house 36, 6 january 1785, son of «joh: baptista» and «catharina nata jablich … bucari», with antonius couaz and maria his wife, cives pisinenses, standing godparents and maria chrismanich the midwife.
carlo de franceschi's baptism, 19 october 1809 — with his death written in the margin

gologorica baptisms, image m01069064, folio 51. house 17. «die 19na 8bris 1809 · carolus josephus defranceschi natus die 17ma hujus, vespere» — born on the 17th in the evening, baptised on the 19th. parents «dnus josephus defranceschi et domna lambertina ejusdem uxor»; godfather «dnus gioanni curelich, petinensis», of pićan. a later hand has added the cross and «8/i 1893» above his name — the day he died, entered in the book that recorded his birth.
franciscus xaverius defranceschi, born 19 february 1816, baptised the 25th

gologorica baptisms, image m01069078, foot of folio 65, opening the year 1816. house 17. «die 25ta februarii 1816 · franciscus xaverius joseph defranceschi natus die 19na hujus mensis» — born on the 19th, baptised on the 25th. parents «dnus josephus defranceschi et dna lambertina ejusdem uxor». one godparent is entered nobilis, «da lindaro». a later hand has added «† 4 januarii 1893» above the name. carlo's brother, and the entry that proves the 1826 census was recording baptism dates, not births.
maria aloysia defranceschi, born 14 august 1811 at eight in the morning

gologorica baptisms, image m01069070, folio 57, house 17. «die 17ma augusti 1811 · maria aloysia defranceschi nata die 14ta hujus hora 8va mane» — born on the 14th at eight, baptised on the 17th. parents «dnus josephus defranceschi et dna lambertina ejusdem uxor»; godfather «joannes ant. torbulla, parochus paspergensis» — the parish priest of paz. carlo's sister. this frame was skipped when the book was being read at every third frame, and found only when the gaps were closed.
clementina, 28 january 1821

gologorica baptisms, image m01069086, folio 73. «28 januarii 1821 · clementina nata hodie hora 4ta mane», house 104, of «dnus joseph defranceschi, civilis» and «dna lambertina uxor ejusdem, nata pesle». this child does not appear in any later record of the household — and a second clementina is baptised in the same family twenty months afterwards.
clementina maria, 3 october 1822 — and a peschle out of volosca

gologorica baptisms, image m01069089, folio 76. «6 8bris 1822 · clementina maria nata die 3 8bris hora 10 pomeridiana», house 17, of «dnus joseph defranceschi» and «dna lambertina ejus uxor nata pesle». the godparents are «pietro ant. defranceschi» and «amalia peschle ex volosca» — corrected 11 october 2026 from «ex silesia», which this archive published and which the word does not say; see the magnified plate. her birth date matches the one this archive already held; her elder namesake of 1821 does not.
enrichus jacobus defranceschi, born 11 march 1830 — and a house number corrected to 104

gologorica baptisms, image m01069102, folio 89, the opening of the year 1830 (the foot of the page is not on this image). second entry: «die 28va martii · enrichus jacobus defranceschi natus 11ma martii hora 5ta mane», of «dnus josephus defranceschi, civilis» and «domina lambertina ejusdem uxor nata pesle»; godparents «giacomo giacich» and «jos.a teresa giacich»; midwife «marianna uxor stanislai rabar». his domus cell has been written, struck through and replaced with 104 — and so has the cancinich entry two rows below, 37 struck to 73, while 36, 16 and 50 on the same page are clean. from 1830 this book counts houses twice. and of the five fathers on this image, four are «agricola»; the fifth is «dnus … civilis».
three defranceschi women in fourteen months — gologorica, 1840 and 1841

gologorica baptisms, image m01069115, folio 102, the fair copy of 1840 and 1841 in petrus milcetich's hand. first entry, 20 february 1840, house 2: «franciscus natus hodie», of «joannes sestan, agricola» and «sancta alexandra nata defranceschi», with godparents «franciscus marciolin» and «clementina defranceschi», conditio «ille clavium faber, haec civis» — he a locksmith, she a citizen. near the foot, 14 april 1841, house 2 again: godparents «josephus selesco ac francisca defranceschi», the surname squeezed onto the line below. between them, the rural dean's certificate: «vidi. petinae die 15 januarii 1841 — coverlizza, decanus». none of the three women is entered anywhere in this book as a child.
two defranceschi wives and a defranceschi daughter — gologorica, november 1843

gologorica baptisms, image m01069118, folio 104, headed «liber baptizatorum in ecclesia parochiali gollogorizzae». the last two entries on the page are both defranceschi. 11 november 1843, house 2: «maria nata 7 hujus», of «antonius sestan» and «joanna nata defranceschi», godfather «franciscus defranceschi» — the second sestan of that house to marry a defranceschi daughter out of gračišće. 15 november 1843, house 5: «teresia nata 14 hujus», of «antonius defranceschi» and «francisca», godparents «antonio salamon et maria soror», entered cives — a birth date this archive had only as «about 1843». the godfather's surname reads salamon and is not claimed: it has not been tested against the same scribe writing palman, and this archive withdrew a «salman» reading four days earlier for exactly that reason.
the test: petrus milcetich writing palman and writing salamon, at one magnification

two words from the same hand, two years apart, cut from the film at the same scale and set one above the other — the only test this archive accepts for a doubtful word. above: «franciscus palman sutor», gologorica baptisms folio 102, 28 april 1841 (m01069115). below: «antonio salamon et maria soror», folio 104, 15 november 1843 (m01069118). the initials are not the same letter: palman opens with a tall closed majuscule bowl, salamon with a small low pointed stroke and no bowl at all. the bodies are not the same length: palman runs a-l-m-a-n, salamon runs a-l-a-m-o-n, with a rounded a between the l and the m where palman has none. the 1843 word is not palman.
«maximilianus defranceschi et soror adelaidis» — the register names a brother and sister, 1847

gologorica baptisms, image m01069122, folio 108, the year 1847 in petrus milcetich's hand. three defranceschi entries. 23 january, house 5: «leonardus natus heri» of «antonius defranceschi» and «francisca nata defranceschi» — born 22 january 1847, with a later hand adding «† 20.xii.1917» beneath, seventy years on. 21 october, house 7: the godparents of jacobus cocolet's child are «maximilianus defranceschi et soror adelaidis», entered cives — the «maximilianus antonius» and «maria adelgidis» the 1826 status animarum lists among the ten children of josephus and lambertina, named here as brother and sister by the register itself. 12 september: «antonius defranceschi» stands godfather again.
a boy baptised in 1851 and a hand closing his life in 1935

gologorica baptisms, image m01069126, folio 112, the year 1851. «junii 7ᵃ · [domus] 3 · joannes natus heri», of «antonius sestan» and «joanna nata defranceschi», godparents «joannes ivich et francisca defranceschi» — born 6 june 1851. beneath it, in a twentieth-century hand, «† 27/2 1935»: eighty-four years later somebody came back to this page and closed him. the 1826 status animarum gives the same child's birth as 6 june 1852 — the same day and month, one year out — which is one of two places where that census and this register disagree about this household while agreeing exactly about the rest.
a peschle stands godfather by proxy — gologorica, 4 november 1860

gologorica baptisms, image m01069135, folio 121. «1860. 9bris 4ᵃ · [domus] 7 · anna-maria francisca nata 28 8bris», of «franciscus defranceschi, civis» and «clotildis ortis» — house 7, the defranceschi house. the godparents are «anselmus peschle … per procuratorem» and «beatrice ortis», both cives: a peschle standing godfather to a defranceschi child through a proxy, so he was not in the village that day. a later hand has written «† tergesti 22-6-1941» above the entry — she died at trieste, eighty years on, and this archive already held that date from elsewhere. the midwife is catharina cattenar.
the page where one priest stops and another begins — gologorica, 1862

gologorica baptisms, image m01069137, folio 123. «petrus milcetich, parochus» writes the first six entries of 1862 and signs his last on 13 march; from 13 april every entry is «blasius zwölber, administrator». the 1826 status animarum says milcetich died on 22 march 1862 — the register brackets that date without naming it. entry 8, 27 april, house 7: «victor josephus natus 22 aprilis», of «franciscus xav. defranceschi, possessor» and «clotildis ortis», godparents «natalis stefanovich» and «maria defranceschi», cives. entry 9 names two women «grah» with «missan» written beneath the surname in both.
«quae copiae collationatae anni 1835 concordant cum hoc originali libro» — a second set of these registers existed

gologorica baptisms, image m01069111, foot of folio 98 — in the strip this archive had been cropping off. ruled across the page beneath the last entry of 1835: «quae copiae collationatae anni 1835 concordant cum hoc originali libro. ex officio decanatus, petinae die 7 maij 1836», signed by the dean. the parish made a copy of each year's register; the dean collated it against the original and certified that the two agreed. so a second, certified set of these books went out of the parish every year — and the one in the picture is the one that stayed.
«remigius cæsar», son of a doctor of medicine — gologorica, 9 october 1864

gologorica baptisms, image m01069140, foot of folio 126. «1864 octobris 9 · [domus] 4 · remigius cæsar natus 1 oct.», of «albertus peschle, doctor medicinæ» and «victoria nata calligarich»; godparents «luigi de franceschi» and «celestina v.da calligarich», conditio «industriante»; midwife joanna crismanich. this archive had already found a «dr cäsar peschle», medical officer of the k.k. landwehr, commissioned in 1895 and still on the lists in 1918 — and had written under him «nothing joins him to lambertina». a caesar peschle born at gologorica on 1 october 1864 to a physician would be just under thirty-one when that commission was granted.
twins, and the register says which came first — gologorica, 5 april 1868

gologorica baptisms, image m01069147, folio 134. two consecutive entries, both «1868 maji 31ma», both house 7, both of «franciscus defranceschi, possidens» and «clotildis nata ortis». the first: «maria henrica die 5 a[prilis] prius nata» — born earlier. the second: «clotildis adelaidis die 5 aprilis nata». the register is recording a twin birth and stating the order of it. maria henrica's godfather is «henricus defranceschi»; clotildis adelaidis's godparents are «henricus defranceschi» and «adelaidis defranceschi», entered possidentes — the brother and sister whose «et soror» entries of 1847 and 1852 placed adelaidis in this family. each twin carries her godparent's name.
a man who could not write acknowledges his son — and a defranceschi witnesses it, 1870

gologorica baptisms, image m01069150, folio 140. beside the baptism of 30 december 1870, house 26, the infans column is given over to a declaration running the depth of the page: «ego cum signo crucis signatus antonius rup—ovič, agricola … declaro … esse verum me patrem hujus creaturæ antonii» — i, signed with the sign of the cross, declare that i am the true father of this child antonius. beneath it, two witnesses: «joannes defranceschi» and «franciscus palman». a man who signs with a cross needs witnesses who can write, and the parish found two.
an italian state office rules on the surname in 1920, and cites a birth certificate of 1626

gologorica baptisms, image m01069151, folio 142 — a typewritten slip pasted over the entries of 2 and 10 july 1871, hiding the baptisms underneath. «giusta lettera del commissariato gen. civ. per la venezia giulia dd 10/12 1920 n. 1x-4411/563 la grafia originale del cognome di questo battezzato è “de franceschi”, ciò che risulta dalla fede di nascita del suo proavo leonardo de franceschi nato a luincio dd. 23/6 1626. d’ordine del commissariato gen. civ. — avv. melone.» the commissariato generale civile per la venezia giulia was the italian civil administration of the territories annexed after 1918. luincio is luincis in carnia, seat of the pieve matrice di gorto — the mother church whose book of baptisms this archive has already quoted from, for 1789.
from državni arhiv u pazinu, microfilm zm34k-214 — the family’s own copy of the film
the book’s own index names the two defranceschi households, and the byname

gologorica baptisms 1784–1880, image m01069167 — the book’s own alphabetical index, letter d. two defranceschi households, told apart by their fathers and by a byname. «defranceschi joan. bapta defuncti josephi, n° 5»: joseph (p. 2), franciscus (struck out), catharina «quæ obiit» (p. 4), catharina helena (p. 6), maria rosalia (p. 8), maria antonia (p. 11). «defranceschi joanes bapta detti leonardi, n° 12»: franciscus antonius (p. 3), joanes bapta (p. 6). the index is the one place in the book that names the two households side by side — and «detti leonardi» is the byname this archive had from elsewhere, here in the register’s own hand. this frame shows only the first of the two households, n° 5; the second block, «detti leonardi», n° 12, is not on this image.
carlo de franceschi stands godfather to his brother’s son, 1874

gologorica baptisms, image m01069156, folio 150. «1874 octob. 11 · franciscus carolus natalis die 6. octob. natus», of «franciscus defranceschi, possidens» and «clotildis nata ortis» — godparents «carlo defranceschi» and «natale stipanich», entered cives, with «† tergeste 17-2-1942» added in the margin. carlo de franceschi, the historian this archive leans on, stands godfather to his brother’s son six days before his own sixty-fifth birthday, and the child carries both godparents’ names. at the foot of the same page, written out by hand, is a second copy of the 1920 commissariato ruling on the family surname. this image shows the foot of the page only: the dean's signature of 12 january 1875 and, beneath it, the second copy of the 1920 ruling. the baptism of 11 october 1874 itself, with its godparents and the margin note, lies above this crop and is not on this image.
clementina defranceschi, two days and eleven hours old — 30 january 1821

gologorica deaths 1784–1880, image m01069259, page 62. «1821. die 30ma januarii hora ½ 4ta a meridie · [domus] 104 · clementina filia d.ni josephi defranceschi · dierum 2 et horarum 11½ · imperfecta structura», buried 1 february 1821, ant. ferdinandus mocovich, parochus. her baptism, two folios away in the other book, has her born on 28 january 1821 at four in the morning at the same house 104. from 28 january at 4 a.m. to 30 january at half past three in the afternoon is two days and eleven and a half hours. the arithmetic closes exactly, and the two clementinas of this family stop being a question.
a maximilianus defranceschi who died in 1817, eleven years before the one this archive knows

gologorica deaths, image m01069257, page 58. «1817. die 19 xbris hora 10ma noctis · [domus] 17 · maximilianus joseph defranceschi, d.ni josephi filius · annorum 4 · vermes et phthisis cum febri maligna» — buried the next day at sunset «ob signa putrefactionis». four years old, so born about 1813: a son of josephus and lambertina this archive did not have, falling between maria aloysia (1811) and franciscus xaverius (1816). the maximilianus antonius the archive knows was born 8 january 1828 — eleven years after this child was buried. the name was reused, as clementina’s was.
the death book’s index of the defranceschi, and the pages it points at

gologorica deaths 1784–1880, image m01069301 — the alphabetical index at the back of the book, letter d. under «defranceschi joseph · nº 17»: catharina (p. 3), joseph q. joan. petri (5), joseph joanis baptæ (8), maria antonia (11), sancta (12), catharina uxor joan. baptæ (12), r.dus joan. mathias ex parochus (15), d.na helena vidua q. josephi (25), catharina filia q. josephi (30), d.nus joan. bapta q. josephi (39), maximilianus filius jos. junioris (58), clementina filia dicti d.ni (62), maria filia q.m joan. bapta (66), amalia filia josephi (67). two further households follow: «joanes bapta detti leonardi nº 12» and «leonardus nº 10». the index was read here before; its pages had not been opened. this frame ends at the entry for d.nus joan. bapta q. josephi (39); the entries from maximilianus (58) onward and the two further households lie below it and are not on this image.
a defranceschi who had been parish priest of gologorica — died 29 march 1797

gologorica deaths, image m01069235, page 15. «idem · [domus] 63 · 29 martij [1797] · admodum r.dus d.nus math. de franceschi ex paroch: gallogaz · annorum 62 · paralisia». the very reverend mathias de franceschi, formerly parish priest of this place — the word under «ex paroch:» is «gallogaz», the village's own name, read at full size on 11 november 2026; from 6 october until then it was read as a gallignana word, which was wrong — dead at gologorica aged sixty-two, of a stroke. the year is not on the entry; the page order gives 1797. born about 1736. this archive held him as a name with the single word «don» against it.
domina helena, widow of the late josephus defranceschi — 26 august 1804, aged eighty-four

gologorica deaths, image m01069240, page 25. «idem · [domus] 36 · 26 augusti [1804] · d.na hellena, vid[ua] q. josephi defranceschi ex loco · annorum 84 · maligna» — a malignant fever. eighty-four in august 1804 puts her birth about 1720. this archive carries her as 1725–1809, so the register disagrees with it at both ends. higher on the same opening stands the deanery visitation of 17 july 1804, signed by franciscus franovich — the same inspection, on the same day, that signs the baptism book.
the french took the registers — and the priest wrote down what that cost him

gologorica deaths, image m01069247, page 38. ruled across the column between two entries of 1812: «n.b. hic liber cum aliis ex justa ordinationem regiminis gallici consignatus fuit municipalitati pisinensi die 20ma julii 1812, et die 5ta januarii 1814 fuere restituti ab administratione dominali; quamobrem mortuorum eorum nomina, qui per hoc intervallum obierunt, fideliter ex more solito hic retuli: ego idem parochus mocovich qui supra.» — this book with the others was handed to the municipality of pazin by order of the french government on 20 july 1812 and given back on 5 january 1814, so the names of those who died in the interval the priest has entered here afterwards, faithfully and as usual. beneath it a second note records a nil: «from 10 july to 19 august exclusive nobody died in this parish».
amalia de franceschi, eight months old — 22 december 1826

gologorica deaths, image m01069262, page 67. «die 22 xbris 1826 hora 3tia postm. · [domus] 17 · amalia de franceschi, filia josephi · 8 men[ses] · febres gastricæ, mali[gnæ]» — buried on the 24th at ten in the morning. eight months old in december 1826 puts her birth about april that year. the pedigree carried her as a child of josephus and lambertina with no dates at all; and because she died an infant she cannot be the adelaidis who stands godmother in 1847, 1852 and 1868, which removes one strand from the tangle of names round this household.
«defranceschi, parochus loci» — a defranceschi buries the parish, 1787

gologorica deaths, image m01069230, page 5. the leftmost column of this register is sepeliens — who performed the burial — and at the head of 1787 it reads «[defran]ceschi p[aro]chus loci»: defranceschi, parish priest of this place. he signs the burials of his own village, and most of the entries beneath run «idem», the same man, down the page. taken with page 15, where the very reverend mathias de franceschi is buried in 1797 styled «ex paroch: gallogaz» — formerly parish priest of this place — the priest who signs the burials here in 1787 is the man buried as gologorica's former priest.
dominus joannes baptista defranceschi, widower — 23 january 1813

gologorica deaths, image m01069248, page 39. «admodum r.dus d.nus martinus sestan, parochus novacensis, de licentia mea parochi presentis · [domus] 17 · die 23. januarii 1813 · d.nus joannes bapta defranceschi, viduus, defuncti josephi filius · annorum 60 · phthisis». head of house 17 and of the titled branch, dead at sixty of consumption — and buried by the parish priest of novaki, by licence of gologorica’s own. three rows down stands «josephus de-prato», a surname split across a line break that reads as a defranceschi at page scale and is not one.
house 36 in eighteen months — a daughter of six months, a spinster of fifty-eight, a wife of twenty-six

gologorica deaths, image m01069233, page 12 — house 36 in a bad eighteen months. «26 aprilis 1792 · sancta defranceschi, cœlebs · annorum 58 · febris putrida», buried by joh. marinich, canon of gallignana. and four weeks later, «21 maii · catharina defranceschi · annorum 26 · apoplexia», buried by petrus anicich, priest of novaki — the same petrus anicich who signs this parish’s visitation as dean sixteen years later. on the facing page, 16 july 1791: «maria antonia defranceschi · mensium 6 · vermes». the officiant column of both pages reads «defranceschi, parochus». this image shows the page of 1792 only; the entry for maria antonia, 16 july 1791, is on the facing page and is not in this frame.
the family that is not this one — deprato, house 6

gologorica deaths 1784–1880, image m01069301 — the index block for a family that is not this one. «deprato leonardus · n.º 6»: leonardus (1), joanes filius joanis baptæ (1), sebastianus ejus filius (9), r.dus joseph deprato ex parochus (20), cattarina uxor joan. baptæ (24), joannes bapta viduus (32), josephus filius q. joan. baptæ (39), catharina vidua q. leonardi (50). set that beside the defranceschi block on the same opening and the two families share a joannes baptista, a catharina wife of joannes baptista, a reverend former parish priest, a widow and a josephus son of the late joannes baptista — and both surnames begin «de—» and break across lines. page 39 carries one of each.
three «de—» surnames on one page — defranceschi, deprato, defranich

gologorica deaths, image m01069231, page 7 — three «de—» surnames on one page. the officiant column alternates between «defrances[chi] p[res]b[yte]r loci» and «d. joseph: deprato, ex paroch[us]» — the parish priest of this place and a former parish priest, two different families. and the sixth entry, 10 august 1788, is «antonio de-franich, annorum 70, febris putrida» at house 84 — a third surname again, and not a defranceschi. at page scale all three read alike; only the syllable after the line break tells them apart.
smallpox at gologorica, september 1789 — a child from each defranceschi house, nine days apart

gologorica deaths, image m01069231, foot of page 8 — september 1789, and the cause column says pustulla almost all the way down: nine of the eleven entries visible in this half of the page. among them, nine days apart: «idem · [domus] 31 · 10 7bris · joh. defran-ceschi fil. ther[esiae] · annorum 7 · pustulla» and «idem · [domus] 36 · 19 7bris · joseph. defran-ceschi ex loco · annorum 5 · pustulla» — a seven-year-old from house 31, the «detti leonardi» branch, and a five-year-old from house 36. the first is named for his mother: theresia, the grach wife of that house.
antonius defranceschi, 17 september 1802 — the entry behind a tree-only man

gologorica deaths, image m01069238, page 21. the middle entry reads «idem · 29. · 17 7mbris · antonius de=franceschi ex loco · ann[orum] 60. · hectica» — house 29, died 17 september 1802, male, catholic, aged sixty, of consumption. the archive carried this man from the family tree with a birth and a death year and no document of any kind behind either. sixty years in september 1802 puts his birth about 1742, which is the year the tree gives. the faint line below is a later, lighter-inked entry for catharina, wife of joannes, aged 52 — the same pale hand that runs through this book.
«defranceschi leonardus n.º 10» — a third defranceschi house in the index

gologorica deaths, image m01069301 — the book's own index. the block is headed «defranceschi leonardus n.º 10» and carries exactly one name: «antonius leonardi pater · 21» — antonius, leonardo's father, page 21. above it the index heads two further defranceschi households, «joseph n.º 17» and «joanes bapta detti lonardi n.º 12», and below it «deprato leonardus n.º 6», a different family with the same given names. the priest who made this index was filing by household, not by surname.
the bell-ringing ledger on the death book's flyleaf — in italian, not latin

gologorica deaths, image m01069227 — the flyleaf inside the front cover, before the register proper begins. five entries, 1801–1805, and they are in italian where the whole book that follows is in latin. each reads to the same formula: «è passata da questa alla miglior vita … fù dato un ducato o sian l. 6 alla chiesa per suono di tutte tre campane» — a ducat, six lire, to the church for the ringing of all three bells. it is a payment ledger, not a register of deaths: the people in it are in the latin register too, but the dates do not always agree. this frame shows the first three entries (1801–1802); the other two lie below it.
joseph deprato, retired parish priest of cerovlje, dead at gologorica in 1801

gologorica deaths, image m01069237, page 20, second entry: «idem · 61. · 17 8bris · admodum r[everen]dus dominus joseph deprato, ex parochus cerovgl[ie], jubilatus, ex loco gallogor. · ann[orum] 80 · senect[us]». house 61, 17 october 1801, aged eighty, of old age. a former parish priest of cerovlje, retired — «jubilatus» — and living at gologorica. this is the anchor of the deprato family, whose surname this archive has twice had to separate from defranceschi: he appears in this book's officiant column as «d. joseph: deprato, ex paroch[us]» and heads its index block «deprato leonardus n.º 6».
«fames» — a cause of death the parish wrote down in plain latin

gologorica deaths, image m01069238, page 22, under 1803. the second entry: «idem · 100. · 25 maij · mathia ancich alij cossar, uxor joan: ex rizmanizza · ann[orum] 70 · fames» — hunger. at the foot of the same page, house 4, 12 [9]bris: «math: zabran lukcich smrèquar · ann 67 · egestas» — destitution. the column is headed causa mortis and the priest filled it with the plain word. the same hand had written «egestas» once before, in 1797, for a man of 68 described as having been in service from his youth. this frame shows the top of the page; the house 4 entry at the foot is not in view.
one page, two exposures — and only the second one can be read

gologorica deaths, page 28, filmed twice. left, image m01069241: a loose slip of paper lies across the page and blanks out seven entries. right, image m01069242: the same page with the slip lifted away. the two top entries are identical in both, which is how the pages are known to be the same. everything the slip covered — a mother dead in childbirth, her six-year-old, her three-month-old, and four more — exists only on the right-hand exposure. a duplicate frame is not redundancy; sometimes it is the only complete reading. the crops show only the top of the page and about three of the covered entries; the rest lie below the frame.
1803, page 23 — «famesque», «egestas», and a woman found dead at home

gologorica deaths, image m01069239, page 23, under 1803. house 26, 24 7bris: «dominica zabran uxor mart. zabran · ann 56 · cancrhrena famesque» — gangrene and hunger. house 2, 23 8bris: «hellena vellan alij jugoviza · ann 64 · egestas». house 6, 31 8bris: «mattia zabran … nata ghersan, inventa mortua domi · ann 32 · egestas» — found dead in her house, aged thirty-two, of destitution. with «fames» on the facing page and «egestas» again in november, this single year carries five deaths the priest attributed to hunger or want. the entry for mattia zabran (house 6, 31 october) is below this frame and is not shown.
«catharina deprato … uxor joh: baptista» — the collision this archive had been warning about

gologorica deaths, image m01069239, page 24, first entry: «61. · 13 xmbris [1803] · catharina deprato nata rovisi ex petin, uxor joh: baptista, provis. ex loco · ann 43 · hidrope». house 61 — the same house where the retired priest joseph deprato had died two years before. the archive already holds a catharina defranceschi née jablich, wife of a joannes baptista, dead in 1792 at house 36, aged 26. two women, both «catharina, wife of joannes baptista», eleven years apart in one book, filed in its index under two different households: «defranceschi joseph n.º 17» and «deprato leonardus n.º 6».
«36 vetus · 14 novus» — the register names both numbering systems, beside a defranceschi death

gologorica deaths, image m01069243, page 30. second entry: «idem parochus · 36 vetus · 14 novus · die 12 8bris 1806 · catharina filia defti josephi de=franceschi, cælebs ex loco · 56 ann. · asthma». the house column has been split in two and the priest has labelled the halves «vetus» and «novus» — old and new. the archive had inferred a renumbering from two unlabelled columns in the baptism register; here the death register says so in its own words, and dates it to about 1806. three more pairs sit on the same page: 8 vetus → 52 novus, 107 vetus → 76 novus, and one reading uncertainly as 70 → 8?.
«gratis» — the register says which burials were not paid for

gologorica deaths, image m01069246, page 35, 1811. under the officiant's name on three consecutive entries — houses 83, 34 and 93 — the parish priest has written «gratis». the burial was free. read against the bell-ringing ledger on this book's flyleaf, where five families paid a ducat for the ringing of all three bells, and against the deaths this same register attributes to «fames» and «egestas», the parish's economy of death is legible in three registers of the same book: who paid for bells, who paid nothing, and who starved. two entries on this page give the cause as «variola» — smallpox, now under its proper name where the 1789 epidemic was written «pustulla». the two «variola» entries are lower on the page and are not in this frame.
«joannes baptista deprato, viduus» — and a dean's signature across the foot of the page

gologorica deaths, image m01069244, page 32: «idem parochus · 6. · die 30ma martii 1809 · joannes baptista deprato, viduus · 56 · inflammatio et tussis». a widower — and the archive holds his wife, «catharina deprato … uxor joh: baptista», dead in 1803 at house 61. he dies at house 6. below, written across the page: «die 5 julii 1816 in visitatione decanali … decanus recog[novit] et approbavit» — one of a series of decanal inspections, with petrus anicich signing in 1807 and 1808 and a note of visitation in 1805.
1815 — a village judge's son, starved in another country, entered on a certificate from the parish that buried him

gologorica deaths, image m01069249, page 41. the foot of the page, 27 april 1815, house 80: «joannes ancich q.m judicis joannis filius ex rismagnizza · annor. 40 · fames». the date column carries the circumstance — «obiit in istria ex veneto, quo egestatis causa cum familia sua se contulerat», he died in venetian istria, whither he had removed with his family for reason of destitution — and the officiant column carries the proof: «adm. r.dus d.nus matthæus loganis, parochus foscolini in istria ex veneta, sepelivit ibi in ecclesia s.ti rochi, uti ex ejusdem parochi attestato patet». above it on the same page, a man of 54 dead of «inopia consumptus», consumed by want, at eight at night; and a stranger of about 40 from the parish of paasberg «inventus mortuus in via» — found dead on the road. the paasberg entry is not in this frame.
1 april 1816 — «lucia rabar, ann. 4, fames»

gologorica deaths, image m01069250, page 44, 1816. third entry, house 84: «lucia rabar georgii filia haeredis anich · ann. 4, mens. 5½ · fames». a child of four years and five months, dead of hunger. two entries below, house 75, 16 april at nine in the morning: «joanes bapta udovicich alias jacotich … ann. 58, mens. 10 · tussis et fames». the crisis that began on page 41 in the spring of 1815 is still killing a year later. at the foot of the page a woman is identified as wife of the «suppanus» — the župan, the village headman — which, with the «judex» whose son starved in venetian istria, puts two of the village's officeholding families inside the same casualty list. the entry naming the wife of the suppanus is at the foot of the page and is not in this frame.
one page, seven entries, one word: «fames»

gologorica deaths, image m01069254, page 51 — 26 april to 8 may 1817. seven burials, and the causa mortis column reads the same for every one of them: «fames». hunger. franciscus schina, widower, 63 · simon udovicich gospod, 51 · michael rovis alias benulla, 53, buried at san pietro in selve · vitus rade, unmarried, 65 · joanes pelesco, not quite 11 · joanna rabar, not quite 7 · maria rabar née flegar giacotich, 50. a small cross is pencilled beside each cause. joanna is the third daughter of the same house to die this way: her sisters lucia, four, and anna, three, had gone in april 1816 and january 1817.
«debilitates fame mendicando» — weakened by hunger while begging

gologorica deaths, image m01069253, page 50, house 19, 25 april 1817 at seven in the morning: «joannes batta crismarich alias covacich · annor. 64, mens. 2 · debilitates fame mendicando, pleuritide obiit» — weakness from hunger while begging; he died of pleurisy. above it, house 60, 1 april: «maria uxor francisci schina nata rabar · 67 · fames», who «obiit paalbergæ» and was buried by the parish priest of paasberg — the second parishioner in this crisis to die outside the parish and be entered here on another priest's word. the entry for maria schina (house 60, 1 april) is higher on the page and is not in this frame.
january 1817 — the children

gologorica deaths, image m01069252, page 47. 18 january, house 105: «antonius rade alias picin · 39 · fames», found at daybreak dying in the open — «sub mane inventus moribundus sub dio in abysso». 21 january, house 73: «georgius udovicich alias scloch, michaelis filius · ann. 7 · fames» — his brother antonius, six, had died five days earlier. 26 january, house 81: «anna rabar, georgii filia haeredis ancich · ann. 3 · fames». 3 february, house 105: «helena, filia defti antonii rade alias picin · ann. 3 · fames» — the daughter of the man in the first entry, sixteen days after her father. the entry for helena rade (3 february) is below this frame and is not shown.
a death entered two months late, and the priest explains why

gologorica deaths, image m01069256, page 56. house 121: «mathias braticich defti matthiæ filius · ann. 16, mens. 2 · fames», buried by «adm. r.dus d.nus philippus jacobus sirol, parochus ad st petrum in sylvis» — san pietro in selve. he died on 2 july 1817 and sits among the september entries, with a note saying so: «nb. hic inscriptus, quia mense 7bri demum mors ejusdem scripto tenus ab eodem parocho annunciata fuit» — entered here because only in september was his death announced in writing by that parish priest. the entries around it have shifted cause: «fluxus» — dysentery — which followed the hunger through august and september. top right, a conservation label filmed with the page: water damage · oštećeno od vlage.
maria defranceschi, house 12 — and the chaplain of barban buried her there

gologorica deaths, image m01069261, page 66: «die 30: 7bris 1826 hora 3tia p.m. · 12 · maria filia defti jo:is b:tæ defranceschi · 37 · hectica · adm.dm rev. d.nus lorentius batel, ca[pell]anus ad s. petrum in barbana ibi sepelivit». this archive already held her death — from the 1826 household census, which gives her age as 37 years 2 months 10 days and so fixes her birth at 20 july 1789. what the death register adds is the house, the cause, the hour, and the fact the census could not carry: she was buried at barban, forty kilometres away, by its chaplain.
1831 — the house number written as a fraction, and it is not the 1806 pairing

gologorica deaths, image m01069264, page 71, 1830–31. from the second entry the house column carries two numbers, written one over the other like a fraction: 65/32, 103/61, 41/17, 111/68, 31/12. the upper is between 1.6 and 2.6 times the lower — the same «about half» relation this archive had already noticed between two unlabelled columns in the baptism register, and emphatically not the relation of the 1806 entries, where the priest wrote «vetus» and «novus» over pairs that scatter (36→14, 8→52, 107→76). two different two-column systems in one set of books.
the same page twice again — and again only the second one is complete

gologorica deaths, page 82, 1846, filmed twice. left, image m01069269: the left edge of the opening is cut off and the month column goes with it, leaving only day numbers — 22, 4, 26, 8, 28, 12, 26 — with no way to tell which month any death fell in. right, image m01069270: the same page framed wider, and the months are there — martii 22, augusti 4, 8bris 26, 9bris 8, 9bris 28, decembris 12, decembris 26. this is the second duplicate pair found by walking this reel, after pages 27–28 where a loose slip hid seven entries on the first exposure. in both cases the duplicate was the readable frame. both frames end at the entry for 12 december; the last entry of the page, 26 december, falls below the bottom edge of both and is not shown here.
«leonardus defranceschi, civis» — house 5, 1848, aged eighty-two

gologorica deaths, image m01069271, page 84: «1848 aprilis 14° · 5 · leonardus defranceschi, civis, refectus ss sacramentis moribundorum et sepultus die 15° hujus · 82 · febris cum senectute». every other adult on this page is «agricola» — a farmer. he is «civis», a burgher, which is the status this family carries wherever it appears in these registers. eighty-two in april 1848 closes exactly on the birth the archive already held for him, 30 january 1766. two entries below, a one-year-old is entered «ex expositis» — a foundling — and another follows in december: children placed with village families, a traffic these registers record without comment.
1850, page 88 — two defranceschi, twenty-eight days and eighty-eight years

gologorica deaths, image m01069273, page 88. at the head of the year: «1850 januarii 21° · 53 · antonia defranceschi, agla, sepul. die 23° huj · dier. 28 · debilitas physica» — a child of twenty-eight days. at the foot: «decembris 8° · 7 · jacobus defranceschi, civis, munitus ss. moribundorum et sepultus die 10 hujus · 88 · febris et senectus». the house column of this page reads 53, 47, 59, 13, 54, 30, 65, 17, 33, 7 — which settles antonia's house as 53 and not 5, where she was baptised four weeks earlier. jacobus is «civis» where the other men are «agla»; he kept house 7, which the 1826 census also gives him. the image shows the head of the page only, down to the entry of 23 september; jacobus defranceschi's entry of 8 december (house 7) and the last two house numbers of the list are below the crop and not on this image.
«ex expositis» and «variolae spuriae» — two words on one page, 1853

gologorica deaths, image m01069276, page 93. house 73, 6 march 1853: «pasqualis-blasius gasparich ex expositis, sep. 8° hujus · 3 · rachithidis» — a foundling of three, and this one carries a local surname where the others carry german ones. house 41, 3 april: «josephus udovicich, agla, refectus s. sacramentis moribundorum et sep. die 5° hujus · 62 · variolae spuriae» — false smallpox, the term for a modified attack in someone already vaccinated or previously infected. its appearance in 1853 says vaccination had reached this parish; the same register wrote «pustulla» for the epidemic of 1789 and plain «variola» in 1811.
«deprato» and «defranceschi» four months apart, in one hand — and the second dies in the first's house

gologorica deaths, image m01069278, page 98, 1858. «maij 14° · 3 · ane maria deprato, agla · 66 · febris», and then «septbris 8° · 6 · mathaea defranceschi, agla, munita s. sacramentis moribundorum, sepulta vero 9° hujus · 86 · hydropisis». written four months apart by the same priest, the two surnames are plainly different words — which is how this reading is secured, since at page scale the «de—» families of this parish are the archive's standing hazard. the interest is the house: 6 is the deprato house, named as such by the book's own index («deprato leonardus n.º 6») and by three deprato deaths. this archive already held mathaea as «wife of leonardus, house 6, maiden surname not captured».
«m. r. d. petrus milcetich, parochus loci» — the entry the baptism book could only imply

gologorica deaths, image m01069280, page 102, third entry of 1862: «22 martii · m. r. d. petrus milcetich, parochus loci, … sacramentis munitus, sepultus est 24. huj. · 58 · pleuropneumonia». the signature in the right-hand column is not his: «franciscus coverlizza, parochus, decanus petinae» — the dean of pićan, whose hand has signed the annual visitation at the foot of these pages since the 1840s, writing the entry for the priest he had been inspecting. for the rest of 1862 the column reads «blasius zwölberr, administrator parochialis». entries 8 and 10 to 13 are all «dysenteria»: the parish lost its priest in march and buried five of its people to dysentery in august and september.
«victor josephus defranceschi, cives · 4 ann · typhus»

gologorica deaths, image m01069284, page 109: «1866 septemb. 11 · 7 · victor josephus defranceschi, cives, sep. die 12. sep. · 4 ann · typhus». house 7 — the house the 1826 census gives his great-grandfather — and «cives» again, the fourth time this register marks the family out from the «agricolae» around it. this archive already held his birth (22 april 1862) and the day he died; what the entry adds is the cause. it is the third typhus in this book in four years, after a man of 27 in 1863 and a boy of 15 in january 1865.
a dash where the name goes — «mortuus natus, sepultus a mulieribus»

gologorica deaths, image m01069282, page 105, 6 september 1864, house 46. the name column begins with a dash and then only a surname: «— rabar, agricola illegit.» the cause column reads «mortuus natus» — born dead — and where the officiant signs every other entry on the page, this one says «sepultus a mulieribus»: buried by the women. an unbaptised stillborn child has no forename to enter and no priest at the grave, and the register records both absences in four words.
january 1870 — five from one house in two weeks, «angina polyposa»

gologorica deaths, image m01069286, page 114. the year opens with five burials from house 28, between 3 and 17 january, and the cause is the same for every one: «angina polyposa» — diphtheria. josephus flegar, 37; matthaeus flegar, 6; joanna flegar, 10; joannes flegar, 4; catharina flegar-sidre, 1. three more follow in march at other houses. in the middle of them, at house 7: «1870 martii 10ma · clementina defranceschi, possidens, munita ss sacram. et sepulta 11. martii · 47 · phthisis» — a different illness, and the entry that moved her death year thirty years, from the 1840 this archive had published to the 1870 the family tree had always given. the image shows the january burials only; the entry for clementina defranceschi of 10 march (house 7) lies further down the page and is not on this image.
«ex expositis tergesti» — the foundlings came from trieste, and the register says so

gologorica deaths, image m01069289, page 119, 4 january 1872, house 36: «anna cima d'or ex expositis tergesti, et sepulta die 5. h.» — from among the exposed of trieste. for twenty-four years this register had entered children as «ex expositis» without saying where they came from, and this archive had recorded the obvious inference — a city foundling hospital — as an inference. here the priest names the city. two entries below, another: «antonia declevaea ex expositis». the surname «cima d'or» is itself a mark of the trade: foundling houses invented names for children who had none.
«virginia defranceschi, agla» — house 6, aged one

gologorica deaths, image m01069291, page 123: «1874 septemb. 12 · 6 · virginia defranceschi, agla, sepulta die 14. h. · 1 anni · hydropisia». this archive held her only from the family tree, with two years, no place and an empty note. the entry gives her a parish, a house, a cause and a burial. two things to notice: the house is 6 — where mathaea defranceschi died in 1858, and which was demonstrably the deprato house in 1801, 1809 and 1817 — and the condition is «agla», agricola, where the defranceschi of house 7 are entered «civis» and «possidens» in this same book.
a bishop's own visitation, and a stillborn child who was baptised in the hand

gologorica deaths, image m01069293, page 128, 1876. ruled across the middle of the page: «vidi in visitatione canonica die 7. julii 1876. g. dobrila, ep[iscopu]s» — a bishop, where every other inspection in this volume is signed by a decanus, a dean. at the foot: «1876 septembris 24 · 14 · maria de=franceschi, mercator, die 25. septembris sepulta est», with the cause «nata mortua» — born dead — and, written above it, «in manu baptizata»: baptised in the hand. that phrase is the whole difference between this entry and the stillbirth of 1864, where the name column is a dash and the officiant column says «buried by the women». baptised, she has a forename and a parish burial.
«josephus defranceschi, possidens» — 22 december 1878, and the second decade corrected in one day

gologorica deaths, image m01069295, page 132: «1878 decembris 22. · 7 · josephus defranceschi, possidens, munitus ss. et sepultus die 24. dec. 1878 · 70 · senectus». this archive had published that he died on 22 december 1857. seventy on 22 december 1878 closes on his birth of 13 march 1808; at 1857 he would have been forty-nine. the day and the month were already right — only the decade was wrong, exactly as with clementina maria defranceschi, corrected the same morning from 10 march 1840 to 10 march 1870. both rows had carried a note saying the burial register was what the question needed, and in both the family tree turned out to be right.
«segue libro nuovo · vol. iv» — the last page, 23 january 1880

gologorica deaths, image m01069297, page 135 — the end of the book. one entry: «23 januarii 1880 · 35 · theresia v.a joannis udovicic gospod · 76 · apoplexia non fuit prov[isa]». below it, ruled across the page and written in italian where the whole volume is latin: «segue libro nuovo · vol. iv» — the new book follows, volume four. the next frame is blank. ninety-six years of a parish's dead, from the first entry of 1784 to this one, end with a note telling the reader where to go next. that volume is not on either reel this family holds.
the letter g in the death book's index — and no grach in it

gologorica deaths, image m01069302 — the «f» and «g» columns of the book's index. each block is a household: a surname, its byname, its house number, and then its members with the page each one died on. «flegar alias giacotich n. 76», «flegar sidre n. 57», «gasparich alias skillas n. 37 et 38», «gaspetich n. 5». the next page completes g with gherbaz «faber ferrarius» n. 22, ghersan n. 98 and n. 108, giurando n. 115, giuratich (cross-referenced elsewhere) and gregorovich n. 86. there is no grach. theresia née grach bore the casa 31 household and an archpriest of her family stood godfather here in 1785, but her people kept no house in this parish and buried nobody in it across ninety-six years. this image stops short of the foot of the g column (flegar sidre, gaspetich and the blocks the next page completes are not on it), so the absence of a grach rests on the whole index and cannot be checked on this image alone.
«extranei» — the death book's list of its own strangers

gologorica deaths 1784–1880, image m01069313 — the final column of the book's index, headed «extranei». after the household blocks end at «zajz giurando n.º 115» the compiler lists six people who died in the parish and did not belong to it, each with where they came from and the page they are on: «gherscovich oliva vid.ᵃ ex cerovglie» (p. 4), the illegitimate twins «jacobus et andreas callagaz … ex cherbune» (p. 13), «ausul maria … ex gradigne» (p. 15), «afflich michael andrejevich ex paas» (p. 41), «chiuch petrus furlanus ex castro ⟨—⟩otti fossor» (p. 48), and «radde lucia … ex territorio cherbune nata bora‹›ıcich q.m joannis» (p. 53). krbune twice; cerovlje once; one friulian. three of the six are on famine-year pages. the word «furlanus» appears here and not in the register entry itself.
a bishop's canonical visitation, and a dean's annual one, on the same page

gologorica deaths 1784–1880, page 128, image m01069293 — two inspections eight months apart, and the only bishop in the whole volume. across the page: «vidi in visitatione canonica die 7. julii 1876. g. dobrila, ep.s» — juraj dobrila, bishop of trieste and capodistria from 29 may 1875 to his death in 1882, which is how this line names the diocese gologorica belonged to. at the foot: «vidi petinae die 18. martii 1877 · jac. bariha, decanus» — the dean of pićan, routine and annual. the deanery at pićan; the diocese at trieste. between the two signatures stands the entry for maria defranceschi, «nata mortua», «in manu baptizata», buried 25 september 1876.
two marriages that join deprato, sestan and defranceschi

gologorica status animarum 1826, images m01069324 (above) and m01069323 (below) — the two lines that refute this archive's published answer to the house-6 question. above: «vincentius sestan, cives, 25 martii 1780» with «maria uxor nata deprato, 9 januarii 1786». below: «jacobus defranceschi, civilitas, 21 julii 1762», then «antonius sestan defᵗⁱ vincentii et mariae, 29 junii 1814» with «joanna uxor nata defranceschi, 25 junii 1818». the death book's index stacks deprato and sestan at house 6; the census shows the two families joined by marriage, and a defranceschi bride marrying into the next generation. jacobus's birth date in the same image — a date, not an age — corrects this archive's unsourced 21 july 1761 to 1762.
two house numbers in one cell — and the column headings that prove it

gologorica status animarum 1826, image m01069362 — the proof that the census's house column carries two numbers rather than a number and a count. the printed headings read «nrus. domus.» and, beside it, «nrus. inquilinorum juxta eorum familias.» the first column holds «36», written over a cancelled hatch, above «64» struck through with a diagonal; the second holds the family count, «2». the household is «josephus udovicich pintar gospod», «rusticus», born 2 november 1796, with «anastasia uxor nata sestan». taken down the book the upper figures climb in order — 28, 29, 30, 31, 32, 33, 34, 35, 36, 39, 40 … — while the lower ones are scattered, which is how the live numbering can be told from the other without reading a hand.
«fede di nascita» — and a letterhead that names the diocese

dapa microfilm zm34k-215, image m01070134 — a loose certificate bound into the gračišće baptism register of 1746–1840. its letterhead reads «diocesi di trieste - capo d'istria nel litorale austriaco» and «distretto di pisino», which independently confirms, from a second parish and nine years earlier, the diocese this archive established on 6 october from a bishop's signature at gologorica. the text certifies that pietro, legitimate son of the late martino krisman, farmer, and the late maria née jerach, born at scopliaco in the parish of gallignana at house 11 on 28 june 1836, was baptised by don antonio scubla, parish priest of gallignana, with giovanni runco and his wife mattea as godparents and maria trelesco as midwife. issued from the parish office at gallignana on 25 march 1867 and signed by mattia zimmermann, parish priest.
from državni arhiv u pazinu, microfilm zm34k-215 — the family's own copy of the film
«smrtni list» — grga defranceschi, zagreb, 11 november 1931

a certified «prepis» of a death entry, photographed; the original is in private hands and was sent to david by a defranceschi. the printed heading «kraljevina: jugoslavija · gradsko poglavarstvo u zagrebu · banovina: savska» is overstamped «hrv. st. katolička crkva · nezavisna država hrvatska», and the top line reads «za regulisanje penzije kod financijske direkcije – prosto od taksa» — so the copy was drawn under the independent state of croatia, 1941–45, for a pension claim on a death of 1931. the entry is from «matica umrlih hrvatske staro-katoličke župe sv. križa u zagrebu», svez. i, str. 13, br. 17. it records that on «jedanaestoga novembra, hiljadu devetstotina trideset i prve» — 11 november 1931 — died «grga defranceschi, bravar kod sekcije držav. željeznica u zagrebu», a fitter with the state railways; spouse «marija rodj. lovrencin, supruga mu»; born «ližnjan (istra)»; resident and died at «zagreb, mošćenička ul. 12»; religion «starokatolička». ⚠ the last row, «dan, mjesec i godina rodjenja» — his birth date — falls at the very bottom edge of the photograph: the label is legible and the value is not, beyond what may be an opening «17».
from private hands — photograph sent to the family, october 2026
«in visitatione» — the decree that says this register is incomplete

dapa microfilm zm34k-215, image m01070082, right-hand page (folio 134) of the «ii liber baptizatorum» of gallignana 1667–1745. bound between a baptism of 17 july 1732 and one of 12 august, in a hand that is not the parish priest's: «die 18 lulij 1732 — in visitatione &c. attentis ommissionibus repertis in libro hoc baptizatorum, seriò admonentur omnes ministri huius sacramenti ut quàmprimùm comodè fieri poterit, imò nulla interposita mora, diligenter adnottentur quæque per negligentiam omissa fuère, et in posterum observetur formula in rituali romano præscripta, sub pœna arbitrii &c. et ita &c.» signed «fran.cus augustinus corsi vic.us gen.lis, et præpositus» — francesco agostino corsi, who four leaves later (m01070086) gives his style in full as «vic.us gen.lis petenensis et præpositus pisini» — vicar general of pedena and provost of pisino (pazin). the visitor records that entries are missing from the book and orders them to be recovered and written in.
«nrus. domus» — the old number struck, the new one written beneath

dapa microfilm zm34k-214, the gologorica status animarum of 1826 (signatura 7.1). three «nrus. domus» cells at twenty times magnification, from pages 19, 43 and 44 (images m01069337, m01069361, m01069362). each carries two figures: an upper one struck through with a diagonal stroke, a ruled line, and a lower one left standing — «20» struck above «27»; «35» struck above «64»; «30» struck above «64», the 64 itself later struck when that household went. the upper figure is the superseded number and the lower is the live one, which is the opposite of what this archive had concluded. pages 43 and 44 carry the same new number, 64, with «nrus. inquilinorum juxta eorum familias» 1 and 2 — so two separately numbered old houses became two tenant families of one new house. the renumbering is many-to-one, and no arithmetic relates the two systems.
«die 9 junij» 1774 — the casa 31 marriage, and the archpriest of krbune signs it

dapa microfilm zm34k-214, image m01068999, right-hand page of the gologorica marriage register 1770–1789 — a book this archive had located but never read. entry 45: «joannes baptista defranceschi q.ᵐ leonardi filius, professionis suæ textor, copulatus est cum virgine theresia, filia antonij grah ex parochia cherbune, à rev.ᵐᵒ d.ⁿᵒ archipresbytero et parocho cherbunensi joanne grah, in facie ecclesiæ coram testibus ibidem notatis.» the year is fixed by the «1774» divider on the facing page and the «1775» divider four entries below. cropped past the entry on both sides so the two neighbours show: the marriage above and the marriage below are both «professionis suæ agricola», which is what makes the defranceschi groom's trade legible as a trade and not a formula. only the lower neighbour's trade, «agricola», is visible in this crop; the entry above is cut off before its profession.
«textor» against the same scribe's «textore» and his two «agricola»

four words from one page of one book, all at six times and at the same magnification — dapa microfilm zm34k-214, image m01068999, gologorica marriages. top: the trade of the defranceschi groom of 9 june 1774. second: «textore» in the ablative, the trade of a witness nineteen days later in entry 62, written over a correction and heavy with it, but the same letters in the same order. third and fourth: «agricola» from the entries of 7 february 1774 and 15 september 1773, the ordinary answer in this column. the reading that had to be excluded was «tector», a plasterer; the third letter of the first word carries a crossing stroke and a loop, and the scribe's plain «c» stands twice in «agricola» below it for comparison. a weaver, not a plasterer, and the only man on the page who is not a farmer.
«num. domus» — the marginal number is the house, and the book proves it four times on one opening

dapa microfilm zm34k-214, image m01069003, the gologorica marriage register. four cuts from one opening at one magnification. top: the column heading written once at the head of the left page — «num. domus», number of the house — which is the only place in the frames read so far that the margin is labelled at all. below it, three entries in which the number in the margin is written again inside the prose as the groom's own «sub n.º»: 13 against «sub n.º 13» (24 november 1783), 108 against «sub n.º 108» (27 january 1784), 70 against «sub n.º 70» (9 february 1784). two further matches on the same opening, 9 and 41, are not reproduced here. the second of these also settles the objection that defeated the first attempt at this question: house numbers in this register run past a hundred, so a margin reading 115 or 110 is an ordinary house and not evidence that the column counts something else. ⚠ the heading and all six in-text matches are in the hand that begins about 1782; the entries of the 1770s carry the same marginal column with no heading and no in-text number to check it against.
the defranceschi parish priest writing his own name, four times, 1782–1788

dapa microfilm zm34k-214, images m01069003, m01069004 and m01069005, the gologorica marriage register. four entries in which the officiant is also the scribe, so the hand is his own. 12 november 1782: «per me parochum franceschi in facie ecclesiæ». 12 january 1785: «per me parocum joannē | mathiam franceschi», the forename broken across the line with «joannē» abbreviated under a macron. 22 november 1785: «ego idem parochus de franceschi hujus loci», this time with the particle. and 29 february 1788, the whole name in one line and nothing abbreviated: «ego joannes matthias de franceschi, parocus hujus loci». the archive had carried this man as joannes mathias franceschi on the strength of a burial of 1797 reading only «math. de franceschi, ex paroch: gallogaz»; the fourth panel is the first document in which the whole name appears, written by him. the second panel was published first, on its own, with the «joannes» flagged as an unconfirmed expansion of an abbreviation — the fourth panel, found an hour later on the next frame, is the second construction that rule asks for.
«sablich» against the same scribe's j — and «sabastiani» settles it

bakar marriage register, page 161, the entry of 10 november 1783, at twice native resolution and all four cuts at the same magnification. top: «d. sabastiani sablich» — the bride's father, and the two words open with an identical letterform. second: «catharinam sablich», the bride, the same letter again. third and fourth: «jacobus» and «josepho», the officiating priest and a witness, written by the same hand within three lines. the scribe's j is a bold stroke that rises high and drops a long descender below the baseline, hooking left; the sablich initial rises and returns to the baseline with no descender at all. the reading is settled from inside the entry rather than by eye: whatever letter opens «sabastiani» can only be an s, and it is the same letter that opens «sablich» twice. the gologorica baptism register of 1786 writes the same woman «nata jablich ex buccari»; that is a second scribe's spelling of a name from another crown land, not a competing reading of this page.

a župan named in full, and the priest four years early — the first page of liber baptizatorum ii

dapa zm34k-214, m01068918: the first text page of «liber baptizatorum ii», gologorica, 1764, two entries at native resolution. top, 18 february 1764 — «ego mathias defranceschi [—]us sacerdos de licentia parochi baptizavi mathiam filiam legitimam defuncti thomæ ac mathiæ jugalium zabran alias strapich». the officiant writes in his own hand, between two entries of the parish priest marcus bancich, and «de licentia parochi» says he holds no office here: four years before the defranceschi priest's earliest previously known appearance, as cooperator in 1768. the word between the surname and «sacerdos» is not settled and is left as «[—]us». bottom, 26 april 1764 — marcus bancich baptises joannes, son of joannes and oliva udovcich, and the godparents are «d.nus matheus flegar, et domina supana joanna vidua defuncti d.ni supani joannis baptistæ defranceschi». the župan's forename pair, which the archive had only from gračišće, is here written by his own parish; he is dead by this date; and his widow — buried in the family's arca inside the parish church on 21 april 1774, five days short of ten years later — carries the title «supana» in her own right.

«supani joannis baptistæ defranceschi» — three times, one hand, 1764 · 1765 · 1767

dapa zm34k-214, «liber baptizatorum ii», gologorica, three godparent clauses at native resolution, all written by the parish priest marcus bancich. top, m01068918, 26 april 1764: «patrini fuere d.nus matheus flegar, et domina supana joanna vidua defuncti d.ni supani joannis baptistæ defranceschi». middle, m01068919, 24 september 1765: «patrini fuerunt thomas flegar, et joanna uxor defuncti supani joannis baptistæ defranceschi». bottom, m01068921, 14 february 1767: the same clause again, for another child of the udovcich gospood. the župan's forename pair, which the archive previously had only from the gračišće registers — his widow's own burial entry of 1774 abbreviates him to «supani joannis defranceschi» — is written out three times in thirty-four months by his own parish. she is a godmother in all three, into her eighties, a decade after he is first entered «defuncti».

«r.dus d. mathias defranceschi», 1766 — and josephus four years early

dapa zm34k-214, «liber baptizatorum ii», gologorica, two godparent clauses at native resolution in the hand of the parish priest marcus bancich. top, m01068921, 15 october 1766: «patrini fuerunt r.dus d. mathias defranceschi et euphemia uxor judicis antonij flegar ex novaco» — the defranceschi priest named by another hand, with the style reverendus dominus, two years after he writes himself into this book as a priest holding no office here. the name reads «mathias defranceschi» exactly as it does in his own entry of 18 february 1764. bottom, m01068919, 16 december 1764: «patrini fuere d.nus joseph defranceschi et lucia uxor defuncti lucæ dujanich ex novaco» — josephus defranceschi as godfather, four years and two months before his earliest previously recorded appearance, and «dominus» here as there. the child is a daughter of «supanus martinus udovcich gospood»: eight months after the defranceschi župan is entered dead, the register gives the title to another man. the crops are two lines deep and are cut off at the right: «euphemia» and «ex novaco» in the upper clause, and «defuncti lucae dujanich ex novaco» in the lower, are not wholly on this image.

petrus antonius baptised, 17 april 1768 — and the archpriest of cerovlje came to do it

dapa zm34k-214, «liber baptizatorum ii», gologorica, at native resolution. top, m01068923, 17 april 1768: «archipresbyter et parochus cerovglienensis dominicus clinzich baptizavit petrum antonium filium legitimum d.ni josephi, et helenæ jugalium defranceschi; patrini fuerunt josephus belch, et matthia uxor jacobi rovis q.m matthæi, ambo pisinenses» — the officiant is the archpriest of the neighbouring parish, not the parish priest who writes the entries either side, and the godparents are both from pazin. the day is the same day the 1826 status animarum gives for petrus defranceschi, «civilitas», fifty-eight years later. middle, m01068922, 11 march 1767: «patrini fuerunt d.nus joannes petrus defranceschi et helena uxor d.ni josephi defranceschi» — helena named as josephus's wife two years before the archive had her, and a fourth dated appearance for joannes petrus, seventeen years after his third. bottom, m01068923: «die 15.ta julij 1768 in prima nostra g.li visitatione · revisus, et approbatus · aldragus ant.us ep.us petinensis» — the bishop of pedena signs the book, and writes the adjective for his own see as «petinensis».

«filius leonardi» and «filius d.ni josephi» — two joannes baptistas on one page, 1769

dapa zm34k-214, m01068926, «liber baptizatorum ii», gologorica — three godparent clauses from the left-hand page of a single opening, at native resolution, all in the hand of the parish priest marcus bancich. top, 24 september 1769: «patrini fuerunt joannes baptista defranceschi filius leonardi, et mathia uxor...» — no «q.m» before leonardi, so the weaver out of carnia was still living; the marriage entry of june 1774 does carry it, and the death register puts his burial at 14 march 1773, between the two. middle, 18 december 1769: «patrini fuerunt d.nus joannes baptista filius d.ni josephi defranceschi, et helena uxor ejusdem d.ni josephi, hujates» — the other man of the name, separated from the first by his father, twelve weeks later on the same page, and the earliest of four attestations of that sonship. josephus's son carries «d.nus»; leonardus's son does not. bottom, 5 february 1770: «et joanna vidua defuncti joannis baptistæ defranceschi, hujas» — the župan's widow, a fourth time, at about eighty-six.

the loose slip inside liber baptizatorum ii — a cerovlje extract certified in 1793

dapa zm34k-214, m01068929: a loose leaf lying across an opening of the gologorica «liber baptizatorum ii», photographed in place and then lifted for the next frame, m01068930. it is a certified extract from the baptism book of cerovlje, not part of this register at all: two persevich baptisms of 5 january 1767 and 12 october 1770, closed «sic de verbo ad verbum ex libro baptizatorum descripsit · die 18. aprilis 1793 · laurentius vicich m.p.a, parochus». the first entry is signed «a me archipræsbitero et parocho dominico clinzich» — the same archpriest of cerovlje who came to gologorica on 17 april 1768 to baptise petrus antonius defranceschi, here in his own parish fifteen months earlier, in a document written for unrelated reasons a quarter-century later. it also names a vice-parochus of cerovlje, gregorius bosich, in 1770.

«canonico matthia defranceschi», 1774 — and the same priest «loco parochi» in 1772

dapa zm34k-214, «liber baptizatorum ii», gologorica, at native resolution. top, m01068932, 31 august 1774: «josephus filius legitimus matthæi, et dominicæ jugalium zabran baptizatus est ab admodum r.do d.no canonico matthia defranceschi, de licentia parochi hujus loci» — in the hand of the parish priest marcus bancich. the defranceschi canonry had been known only from a 1781 entry, flagged because the same register gives the title of titular canon of pedena to a mathias baxa fourteen months earlier; this entry is six years before the baxa one. bottom, m01068931, september 1772: «baptizata est a me sacerdote mathia de franceschÿ, loco parochi» — the same name in what appears to be his own hand, two years before the canonry, with the godparent clause struck through and rewritten at the time. in both, and in 1764 and 1781, he baptises only by the parish priest's leave or in his place — never as the parish's own officer.

the «q.m» tested against itself — one scribe, one man, four years apart

dapa zm34k-214, «liber baptizatorum ii», gologorica, two godparent clauses by the same scribe, marcus bancich, at one magnification. top, m01068926, 24 september 1769: «patrini fuerunt joannes baptista defranceschi filius leonardi» — no «q.m». bottom, m01068932, 29 october 1773: «patrini fuerunt joannes baptista defranceschi q.m leonardi» — the «q.m» present, with its superscript m. between the two, on 14 march 1773, the death register buries «leonardus defranceschi annorum septuaginta sex … professionis suæ textor ex carnia», and the marriage of 9 june 1774 also carries «q.m leonardi filius». the scribe writes the name four times and changes it once, in the gap where the funeral falls: an argument from the absence of «q.m» in 1769 is therefore an argument about this scribe's demonstrated habit, not about silence.

«josepha mariana … nata et baptizata ad cherbunam», 15 march 1776

dapa zm34k-214, m01068934, «liber baptizatorum ii», gologorica, at native resolution. top, 15 march 1776: «josepha mariana [defranceschi] filia legitima joannis baptistæ ejusque uxoris theresiæ, nata et baptizata ad cherbunam per r.dum d.num joannem jadreicich, capellanum cherbunensem, de licentia ejusdem loci cherbunensis parochi et archipresbyteri joannis grah; patrini fuerunt joannes baptista defranceschi, et rosalia defranceschi, filia d.ni josephi defranceschi, hujates.» the surname and the mother's name are both interlined by the same pen, as is rosalia's parentage. the child was born in her mother's parish of krbune and only recorded at gologorica, which is why a sweep of gologorica baptisms by house number could not find her; she is the mariana who died at house 31 on 4 october 1786 aged ten, whose death entry named no parents. bottom, 15 april 1776: «georgius filius legitimus michaelis grah ejusque uxoris dominicæ … patrini fuerunt joannes baptista defranceschi hujas, et maria uxor judicis matthæi silich ex parochia cherbune» — the grah name at gologorica a month later, with a defranceschi godfather.
from državni arhiv u pazinu, microfilm zm34k-214 — the family's own copy of the film · m01068934 (gologorica, «liber baptizatorum ii»)
the canon a second time, and a tailor out of carnia, 7 march 1775

dapa zm34k-214, m01068933, «liber baptizatorum ii», gologorica, at native resolution: «maria elena filia legitima jugalium leonardi, et catharinæ deprato baptizata est ab admodum r.do d.no canonico mathia defranceschi cum licentia mea parochi hujus loci; patrini fuerunt joannes verzin ex carnia, professionis suæ sartor, et rosalia filia d.ni josephi defranceschi ex hac parochia.» three things in one entry: the defranceschi canonry attested a second time, seven months after the 1774 entry and six years before the baxa objection to it; the parish priest marcus bancich writing «cum licentia mea» in the first person, so the canon is plainly not the parish's own officer; and a second man described as out of carnia in a trade, two years after «leonardus defranceschi … professionis suæ textor ex carnia» — the same construction, a different trade, a different family.
from državni arhiv u pazinu, microfilm zm34k-214 — the family's own copy of the film · m01068933 (gologorica, «liber baptizatorum ii»)
«josephi defranceschi mercatoris», 1779 — and the 1774 couple standing together

dapa zm34k-214, m01068938, «liber baptizatorum ii», gologorica, at native resolution. top, 10 february 1779: «mathia filia legitima joannis sherbaz fabri, et ejus uxoris catharinæ baptizata est a me marco bancich parocho hujus loci; patrini fuerunt vitus pavelich, et helena uxor d.ni josephi defranceschi mercatoris ex hac parochia.» the child's own father is entered as a smith in the same line, so the scribe is attaching trades deliberately: this is a merchant household, and it accounts for the «dominus» on every entry, the archpriest fetched from cerovlje for a christening, the godparents from pazin and the «civilitas» the 1826 census still gives the son. bottom, 26 january 1779: «patrini fuerunt joannes baptista defranceschi q.m leonardi, et theresia uxor ejusdem, ex hac parochia» — husband and wife named together as godparents, joining the two names outside the marriage register for the first time.

the defranceschi canon, three more times — 1777 and 1778

dapa zm34k-214, «liber baptizatorum ii», gologorica, at native resolution, all in the hand of the parish priest marcus bancich. top, m01068936, 3 march 1777: «baptizatus est a rev.dissimo canonico mathia defranceschi de licentia mea parochi hujus loci». middle, m01068936, 5 august 1777: «baptizata est ab admodum r.do d.no canonico matthia defranceschi cum licentia parochi». bottom, m01068937, 14 february 1778: «baptizatus est ab admodum r.do d.no can.co mathia defranceschi de licentia mea parochi marci bancich». with the entries of 31 august 1774 and 7 march 1775 these make five, over four years, in one hand, the title written out every time and twice with the parish priest naming himself in the first person as the man granting leave. the canonry had rested on a single 1781 entry, flagged because the same register gives the titular canonry of pedena to a mathias baxa fourteen months before it.

«canonicus et parochus» — the two titles in one hand, 1782

dapa zm34k-214, m01068941, «liber baptizatorum ii», gologorica, at native resolution, both entries written by the man who signs them. top, 10 january 1782: «ego mathias de franceschi, canonicus ecclesiæ cathedralis petinensis, baptizavi infantem natam ex simeone et maria zaoran (sub n.o 73. domus), conjugibus hujus parochiæ (: cujus parochus infirmus est, d.nus presbiter marcus bancich :)» — the canon deputising, and saying in the entry why. bottom, 24 february 1782: «ego joannes mathias franceschi, canonicus et parochus gollogoritiæ, baptizavi filium infantem natum ex giorgio et mathia coscoli sive uglessich». marcus bancich died on 25 january 1782, fifteen days after the first entry; thirty days after his death the same hand has added «et parochus» to its own style. the archive had kept a canon called «mathias» and a parish priest called «joannes matthias» apart because the registers never joined them; here he joins them himself.
